sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血已被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: This episode describes acts of violence against men, women, and children.
sentences.zh: 本期节目讲述了针对男性、女性和儿童的暴力行为。

sentences.en: It won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 并非适合所有听众。

sentences.en: During the 17th century, the Netherlands became one of the world's foremost economic powers thanks to its advances in science, art, and commercial trade.
sentences.zh: 17世纪，凭借在科学、艺术和商业贸易方面的长足进步，荷兰一跃成为世界首屈一指的经济强国。

sentences.en: Then known as the Dutch Republic, its wealth and power flourished through the importing of goods from overseas,
sentences.zh: 当时被称为荷兰共和国的它，通过从海外进口货物，财富与国力蓬勃发展，

sentences.en: with huge ships sent to Asia and Africa to bring back textiles, teas, grains, and spices.
sentences.zh: 大批船只被派往亚洲和非洲，运回纺织品、茶叶、谷物和香料。

sentences.en: A popular proverb among the Dutch during this period was,
sentences.zh: 当时荷兰民间流传着这样一句俗语，

sentences.en: Jesus Christ is good, but trade is better.
sentences.zh: 耶稣基督固然很好，但做生意更好。

sentences.en: The Dutch East India Company, known in its homeland as the VOC, was a chartered company established to coordinate trade in India and other countries throughout Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 荷兰东印度公司在本国被称为 VOC，是一家特许公司，旨在协调印度以及东南亚其他国家的贸易。

sentences.en: Monopolising all trade to the East, it boasted tens of thousands of employees and its own private army.
sentences.zh: 它垄断了所有通往东方的贸易，拥有数万名员工和自己的私人军队。

sentences.en: Ships operating under its licence were enormous vessels called East India Men, built to carry large amounts of cargo as well as passengers,
sentences.zh: 在其许可证下运营的船只是被称为东印度船的庞然大物，专为运载大量货物和乘客而建造，

sentences.en: and equipped with cannons and gunners in case pirates launched an attack.
sentences.zh: 并配备了加农炮和炮手，以防海盗袭击。

sentences.en: Due to their size and weight, these ships moved slowly at an average speed of 5 knots per hour, and typically took 8 months to complete a voyage.
sentences.zh: 由于体型庞大、重量沉重，这些船只航行缓慢，平均时速为5海里，通常需要8个月才能完成一次航行。

sentences.en: In 1628, the VOC commissioned the construction of an expensive new flagship to travel to the company's major trade settlement of Batavia,
sentences.zh: 1628年，东印度公司委托建造一艘昂贵的新旗舰，前往公司位于巴达维亚的主要贸易定居点，

sentences.en: located in what is today the city of Jakarta, in Java, Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 该定居点位于当今印度尼西亚爪哇岛的雅加达市内。

sentences.en: Named after its destination, the Batavia was a grand vessel that was built in just 6 months,
sentences.zh: 以目的地命名的“巴达维亚”号是一艘宏伟的船只，仅用6个月便建造完成，

sentences.en: at the exorbitant cost of 100,000 guilders, more than 4.5 million Australian dollars in today's currency.
sentences.zh: 造价高达惊人的10万荷兰盾，相当于按当今货币计算的450多万澳大利亚元。

sentences.en: The approximately 55 metre tall and 56 metre long ship was made of oak and featured 4 decks,
sentences.zh: 这艘高约55米、长约56米的船只由橡木制成，拥有4层甲板、

sentences.en: 3 masts and 30 guns, and had the capacity to carry 600 tonnes of supplies.
sentences.zh: 3根桅杆和30门大炮，并有能力运载600吨物资。

sentences.en: Its upper works were painted pale green with gold and red detailing, and its figurehead, a wooden carving positioned at the bow, was a lion leaping upwards.
sentences.zh: 其上层建筑被漆成淡绿色，带有金色和红色的细节，船首的船首像是一尊向上跃起的木雕狮子。

sentences.en: In late October 1628, the Batavia set sail from Amsterdam with a fleet of seven other ships, carrying 341 people who ranged from VOC officials, sailors and soldiers,
sentences.zh: 1628年10月下旬，“巴达维亚”号与另外七艘船组成的舰队从阿姆斯特丹起航，载有341人，其中包括东印度公司官员、水手和士兵，

sentences.en: to relatively well-off passengers travelling with their families.
sentences.zh: 以及携家带口旅行的相对富裕的乘客。

sentences.en: A number of the younger passengers were cabin boys, ranging from children to adolescents, who were employed on the ship to wait on others.
sentences.zh: 许多年轻乘客是服务员，从儿童到青少年不等，他们在船上受雇伺候他人。

sentences.en: The Batavia was also packed with valuable cargo, including stone to build factories with,
sentences.zh: “巴达维亚”号还装满了宝贵的货物，包括用于建造工厂的石头、

sentences.en: silverware, jewels, and a fortune in coins that would amount to almost 41 million Australian dollars in today's currency.
sentences.zh: 银器、珠宝以及巨额硬币，按当今货币计算相当于近4100万澳大利亚元。

sentences.en: Life on the ship was harsh, perilous, and unpleasant.
sentences.zh: 船上的生活严酷、危险且令人不快。

sentences.en: Sleeping orders were cramped, and barrels of drinking water were contaminated with worms and algae.
sentences.zh: 睡眠空间拥挤不堪，饮用水桶里爬满了蠕虫和藻类。

sentences.en: Outbreaks of infectious and nutritional deficiency diseases were common, resulting in the deaths of 10 passengers.
sentences.zh: 传染病和营养不良性疾病频发，导致10名乘客死亡。

sentences.en: 27-year-old passenger Lucretia Jarns was travelling from her home city of Amsterdam to be reunited with her husband.
sentences.zh: 27岁的乘客卢克丽霞·雅恩斯正从家乡阿姆斯特丹出发，准备与丈夫团聚。

sentences.en: He was an employee of the VOC and had left to work in the company's Batavia settlement several years earlier.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫是东印度公司的员工，几年前就前往公司在巴达维亚的定居点工作了。

sentences.en: Shortly after his departure, the couple's three young children all contracted a disease and died.
sentences.zh: 就在他离开后不久，这对夫妇的三个年幼孩子全部染病身亡。

sentences.en: It was unusual for a merchant's wife to follow her husband overseas, but Lucretia was heartbroken and lonely.
sentences.zh: 商人的妻子跟随丈夫出海并不常见，但当时卢克雷蒂娅心碎且孤独。

sentences.en: She was born into wealth and occupied a higher social status, resulting in her travelling on the Batavia with a maid and having her own private cabin.
sentences.zh: 她出身富裕，社会地位较高，因此得以带着女佣乘坐“巴达维亚号”并拥有自己的私人船舱。

sentences.en: Lucretia, who was regarded as exceptionally beautiful, consistently rebuffed unwanted attention from a number of men throughout the long voyage.
sentences.zh: 卢克雷蒂娅被视为倾国倾城，在漫长的航程中，她一直拒绝多名男子的无理纠缠。

sentences.en: On the evening of May 14, Lucretia was preparing to retire for the night.
sentences.zh: 5月14日晚，卢克雷蒂娅正准备就寝。

sentences.en: As she made her way back to her sleeping quarters, she was confronted by eight men wearing masks.
sentences.zh: 当她返回住舱时，遇到了八名戴着面具的男子。

sentences.en: Though she couldn't see their faces, they spoke to one another and she heard their voices.
sentences.zh: 虽然她看不清他们的脸，但他们互相交谈，她听到了他们的声音。

sentences.en: The massed assailants dragged Lucretia to a quiet corner on the ship's deck where they reached under
sentences.zh: 这群袭击者将卢克雷蒂娅拖到船甲板的一个僻静角落，他们将手伸进

sentences.en: her skirt to grope her and smeared her face, legs and genitals with tar and animal dung.
sentences.zh: 她的裙子里面上下其手，并在她的脸部、腿部和私处涂抹了焦油和动物粪便。

sentences.en: The assault was over in a matter of seconds.
sentences.zh: 整个袭击过程在几秒钟内就结束了。

sentences.en: Word of Lucretia Jarns' assault reached the Batavia's commander, Upper Merchant Francisco Pelsart, who began investigating the matter.
sentences.zh: 卢克雷蒂娅·扬斯遭袭的消息传到了“巴达维亚号”指挥官、高级商人弗朗西斯科·佩尔萨特耳中，他随即开始调查此事。

sentences.en: Upper Merchant's were VOC officials who were assigned overall responsibility for a particular fleet.
sentences.zh: 高级商人是东印度公司的官员，被委任对特定船队负总责。

sentences.en: Their task was to ensure the voyage would be profitable for the company's directors.
sentences.zh: 他们的任务是确保航行为公司董事带来利润。

sentences.en: Second in command was the ship's captain, followed by the Upper Merchant's deputy, known as the
sentences.zh: 第二负责人是船长，其次是高级商人的副手，被称为

sentences.en: Under Merchant.
sentences.zh: 次级商人。

sentences.en: Francisco Pelsart was aged in his early 30s and was a long-time VOC employee, having already completed a seven-year posting in India.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯科·佩尔萨特当时三十岁出头，是东印度公司的老员工，此前已在印度完成了七年的任期。

sentences.en: Despite his experience, he was indecisive and lacked leadership skills.
sentences.zh: 尽管经验丰富，但他优柔寡断，缺乏领导能力。

sentences.en: His command on the Batavia had been difficult at times, as he often clashed with the ship's captain, Arian Jakobs.
sentences.zh: 他在“巴达维亚号”上的指挥有时十分艰难，因为他经常与船长阿里安·雅各布斯发生冲突。

sentences.en: Aged in his mid-40s, Jakobs was a masterful sailor who had completed many voyages, but he
sentences.zh: 雅各布斯四十多岁，是一位经验丰富、航行过多次的航海高手，但

sentences.en: was bad-tempered, struggled with a drinking problem, and was known to harass female passengers.
sentences.zh: 他脾气暴躁，有酗酒问题，并且有骚扰女性乘客的前科。

sentences.en: Pelsart and Jakobs had first met more than a year earlier, when both were in India, and grew to dislike one another after an altercation that occurred there.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特和雅各布斯一年多前在印度初次相遇，由于当时发生了一起争执，两人逐渐对彼此产生反感。

sentences.en: During the Batavia's voyage, matters came to a head on April 14, 1629, when the ship stopped near the South African city of Cape Town to restock supplies.
sentences.zh: 在“巴达维亚号”的航行中，矛盾在1629年4月14日达到顶峰，当时船只停靠在南非城市开普敦附近补给物资。

sentences.en: By this stage, bad weather had caused the Batavia to separate from all but two other ships in its seven-vessel fleet.
sentences.zh: 此时，恶劣的天气导致“巴达维亚号”与由七艘船组成的船队中除两艘以外的其他所有船只失散。

sentences.en: While Commander Pelsart was on land bartering for goods, Captain Jakobs, without permission, rowed out in a small boat to visit the accompanying ships.
sentences.zh: 当指挥官佩尔萨特在岸上易货购物时，船长雅各布斯擅自乘小船划向同行的船只探访。

sentences.en: While on board, he got drunk and violent, resulting in a fight.
sentences.zh: 在船上期间，他喝得酩酊大醉并表现出暴力倾向，引发了一场斗殴。

sentences.en: By the time Pelsart returned to the Batavia, official complaints had been lodged against his captain.
sentences.zh: 等佩尔萨特返回“巴达维亚号”时，针对其船长的正式投诉已经提交。

sentences.en: Pelsart reprimanded Jakobs, which led to the humiliated Jakobs deeply resenting his superior.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特训斥了雅各布斯，这让受辱的雅各布斯对上司怀恨在心。

sentences.en: Pelsart continued looking into the group assault against Lucretia Yarns.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特继续调查针对卢克雷蒂娅·扬斯的群体性袭击事件。

sentences.en: Though the perpetrators had concealed their faces, Lucretia recognised the voice of one individual
sentences.zh: 尽管行凶者遮住了脸，但卢克雷蒂娅认出了其中一个人的声音

sentences.en: and identified him as Yarn Avertz, the ship's boatswain, a title given to the senior officer in charge of the Batavia's deck.
sentences.zh: 并认出他是亚恩·阿弗尔茨，即船上的水手长，该头衔授予负责“巴达维亚号”甲板的高级军官。

sentences.en: Pelsart also suspected Captain Jakobs was somehow involved and was mindful that the captain had attempted to seduce Lucretia on several occasions, but she rejected him.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特还怀疑船长雅各布斯也牵涉其中，并且他注意到船长曾多次试图勾引卢克雷蒂娅，但遭到拒绝。

sentences.en: Despite Pelsart's suspicions, he knew arresting both Avertz and Jakobs would displease the crew, so he postponed any further action until they arrived at their destination.
sentences.zh: 尽管佩尔萨特有所怀疑，但他知道逮捕阿弗尔茨和雅各布斯会引发船员不满，因此他推迟了进一步行动，直到抵达目的地。

sentences.en: When Captain Jakobs had deserted the Batavia at Cape Town to visit its companionships, he was joined by Commander Pelsart's deputy, an undermerchant named Euronymous Cornelius.
sentences.zh: 当船长雅各布斯在开普敦离开“巴达维亚号”去探访同行船只时，指挥官佩尔萨特的副手、一位名叫尤罗尼穆斯·科内利乌斯的次级商人也加入了他的行列。

sentences.en: Thirty-year-old Cornelius was from a well-off, educated family who belonged to the non-conformist
sentences.zh: 三十岁的科内利乌斯出身于一个富裕、受过良好教育的家庭，信仰不妥协的

sentences.en: Anabaptist church, a denomination considered controversial in the Dutch Republic.
sentences.zh: 再洗礼派教会，该教派在荷兰共和国被认为极具争议。

sentences.en: Cornelius followed in his father's footsteps and became an apothecary, preparing and selling medicines through his own shop in the Dutch city of Harlem.
sentences.zh: 科内利乌斯子承父业成为一名药剂师，在荷兰城市哈勒姆通过自己的店铺配制和销售药品。

sentences.en: In November 1627, Cornelius and his wife had a baby boy who was placed in the care of a wet nurse after his mother became ill.
sentences.zh: 1627年11月，科内利乌斯和妻子生下一个男孩，在妻子生病后，孩子被交由奶妈照顾。

sentences.en: Within several weeks, the infant had contracted syphilis from the nurse's breast milk and died.
sentences.zh: 几周内，这名婴儿通过奶妈的母乳感染了梅毒并夭折。

sentences.en: As syphilis is a sexually transmitted disease, this caused a significant scandal.
sentences.zh: 由于梅毒是性传播疾病，这引发了一场重大的丑闻。

sentences.en: In an effort to save his wife's reputation, Cornelius filed a lawsuit against the wet nurse, though the incident destroyed his career and he found himself unable to pay a number of
sentences.zh: 为了挽救妻子的名誉，科尼利us对奶妈提起了诉讼，尽管这起事件毁了他的职业生涯，并且他发现自己无力偿还

sentences.en: debts.
sentences.zh: 多笔债务。

sentences.en: Moreover, Cornelius was an associate and disciple of infamous painter Johannes Terentius, who was convicted on charges of heresy, blasphemy, atheism and satanism in 1628.
sentences.zh: 此外，科尼利us还是声名狼藉的画家约翰内斯·特伦蒂乌斯的密友和门徒，后者于1628年因被控异端、亵渎、无神论和撒旦崇拜而被定罪。

sentences.en: Fearful that he would be prosecuted next, Cornelius left his wife and fled to Amsterdam, where he took service with the VOC and was posted to the Batavia.
sentences.zh: 由于害怕自己成为下一个被起诉的目标，科尼利us离开妻子逃往阿姆斯特丹，在那里他加入了荷兰东印度公司（VOC），并被派往巴达维亚号。

sentences.en: He quickly formed a friendship with Captain Arian Jacobs, who made his disdain for Commander Francisco Pelsart clear by
sentences.zh: 他很快与阿里安·雅各布斯船长结为好友，雅各布斯毫不掩饰他对弗朗西斯科·佩尔萨特指挥官的蔑视，

sentences.en: remarking that, were it not for the presence of other ships in the fleet, quote, I would treat that miserly dog so that he could not come out of his cabin for 14 days,
sentences.zh: 他扬言道，要不是舰队里还有别的船只，引述他的话说：“我会好好收拾那只吝啬的狗，让他14天都出不了船舱，

sentences.en: and I would quickly make myself master of the ship.
sentences.zh: 我很快就能掌控这艘船。”

sentences.en: In response, Cornelius asked Jacobs,
sentences.zh: 作为回应，科尼利us问雅各布斯：

sentences.en: And how would you manage that?
sentences.zh: “那你打算怎么做到这一点呢？”

sentences.en: Cornelius did not harbour the same personal resentment against
sentences.zh: 科尼利厄斯对佩尔萨特并没有同样的个人怨恨

sentences.en: Pelsart, but was eager to take charge of the Batavia and steal the substantial fortune stored on the ship.
sentences.zh: 但他急于接管“巴达维亚”号，并盗取船上储存的大笔财富。

sentences.en: The pair plotted a mutiny, a form of unlawful rebellion in which the crew of a ship overthrow their leader.
sentences.zh: 两人密谋发动兵变，这是一种船员推翻船长的不合法叛乱形式。

sentences.en: Morale amidst the Batavia's crew was low due to the poor conditions and awful treatment they endured, all for a low pay.
sentences.zh: 由于恶劣的条件、糟糕的待遇以及低廉的报酬，“巴达维亚”号船员们的士气十分低落。

sentences.en: A few were convinced to join in the mutiny, including bosun Jan Evertz, several cadets, a lance corporal, and some of his soldiers.
sentences.zh: 几个人被说服加入叛乱，其中包括水手长扬·埃弗茨、几名学员、一名下士以及他的一些士兵。

sentences.en: In order for their plot to work, they needed to isolate the Batavia by steering it away from its remaining fleet.
sentences.zh: 为了让他们的计划成功，他们需要将“巴达维亚”号与其剩余的船队隔离开来，将其驶向远处。

sentences.en: Captain Jacobs achieved this when the ship encountered a storm shortly after sailing away from South Africa's Cape of Good Hope.
sentences.zh: 当船只在驶离南非好望角不久后遭遇风暴时，雅各布斯船长做到了这一点。

sentences.en: As it wasn't uncommon for ships within a fleet to become separated, this did not arouse any suspicion.
sentences.zh: 由于船队中的船只走散并非罕见之事，这并没有引起任何怀疑。

sentences.en: Despite successfully isolating the Batavia,
sentences.zh: 尽管成功隔离了“巴达维亚”号，但

sentences.en: Cornelius and Jacob's group of mutineers was too small to stage a successful mutiny, so they schemed to turn more men against Commander Pelsart.
sentences.zh: 科尔内利乌斯和雅各布的叛变团伙人数太少，无法发动一次成功的哗变，因此他们密谋策反更多人来对抗佩尔萨特指挥官。

sentences.en: While disguised, they would attack passenger Lucretia Jantz, whom Pelsart harboured romantic feelings for.
sentences.zh: 他们将乔装打扮，袭击乘客卢克蕾蒂娅·扬茨，佩尔萨特对她怀有浪漫的情愫。

sentences.en: In response, Pelsart would then discipline all of the ship's soldiers and sailors, enraging those punished and recruiting them to their cause.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，佩尔萨特随后会惩戒船上所有的士兵和水手，从而激怒受罚之人并将他们拉拢到自己的阵营。

sentences.en: However, their plan failed when Pelsart did not take punitive measures against anybody for the assault on Lucretia.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们的计划落空了，因为佩尔萨特并未就袭击卢克蕾蒂娅一事对任何人采取惩罚措施。

sentences.en: The mutineers speculated that he was just biding his time and intended to take action once their route took them past the
sentences.zh: 哗变者推测他只是在等待时机，打算等他们的航线驶过

sentences.en: Australian mainland, a then-uncharted landmass known as Terra Australia Cincognita, the unknown
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚大陆时采取行动，那是一块当时未标绘的陆地，被称为未知的南方大陆。

sentences.en: Southland.
sentences.zh: 南方大陆。

sentences.en: They quickly put together a new plan, agreeing that as soon as Pelsart made any arrests for
sentences.zh: 他们迅速制定了一个新计划，一致认为只要佩尔萨特为

sentences.en: Lucretia's assault, the mutineers would enter his cabin at night and throw him overboard.
sentences.zh: 袭击卢克蕾蒂娅一事实施任何逮捕，叛变者就会在夜间闯入他的船舱并将他扔下船。

sentences.en: They would then recruit 120 men to run the ship, throw all remaining passengers into the ocean and turn to piracy.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会招募120人来操纵这艘船，把所有剩下的乘客扔进大海，转而当海盗。

sentences.en: They planned to sail the Indian Ocean disguised as a VOC ship before retiring in a far-off land with their stolen loot.
sentences.zh: 他们计划伪装成荷兰东印度公司的船只横渡印度洋，然后带着偷来的战利品在一个遥远的国度隐居。

sentences.en: Over the next few weeks, the mutineers waited patiently for the signal that it was time to revolt.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，叛变者们耐心地等待着起义信号的到来。

sentences.en: During this period, ships travelling from Europe to Asia used strong westerly winds in the Southern Hemisphere named the Roaring Forties to speed east after leaving
sentences.zh: 在此期间，从欧洲开往亚洲的船只利用南半球被称为咆哮西风带的强劲西风，在离开

sentences.en: the Cape of Good Hope.
sentences.zh: 好望角后向东加速航行。

sentences.en: These winds sent them towards the west coast of Australia very quickly, but as there was no accurate way to measure longitude, crews had to gauge when it was time to steer north
sentences.zh: 这些季风将他们飞速送往澳大利亚西海岸，但由于没有精确的方法来测量经度，船员们只能凭

sentences.en: from sight and experience alone.
sentences.zh: 目测和经验来判断何时该转向北方。

sentences.en: If they made a mistake and kept sailing east, they ran the risk of hitting the Australian mainland.
sentences.zh: 如果他们犯了错继续向东航行，就会面临撞上澳大利亚大陆的风险。

sentences.en: June 1629 marked the Batavia's eighth month at sea.
sentences.zh: 1629年6月标志着“巴达维亚”号在海上的第八个月。

sentences.en: By the early morning of June 4, it had been three weeks since Lucretia Yarns had been assaulted by the mutineers and the Batavia was making use of the Roaring Forties.
sentences.zh: 到6月4日清晨，距离卢克蕾蒂娅·扬茨遭到叛变者袭击已经过去了三周，“巴达维亚”号正在利用咆哮西风带航行。

sentences.en: It was a clear night and the moon provided ample light to see by.
sentences.zh: 当时是个晴朗的夜晚，月光提供了充足的视线。

sentences.en: Shortly after 3am, Commander Pelsart was violently thrown from his bed following a rough, terrible movement.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点刚过，一次剧烈而可怕的晃动将佩尔萨特指挥官从床上狠狠地抛了出去。

sentences.en: He ran out to the deck and upon seeing that the ship had run directly into an enormous coral reef, he shouted at Captain Jacobs.
sentences.zh: 他跑向甲板，看到船直接撞上了一座巨大的珊瑚礁，便向雅各布斯船长怒吼起来。

sentences.en: What have you done?
sentences.zh: 你到底做了什么？

sentences.en: That through your reckless carelessness, you have run this noose around our necks?
sentences.zh: 由于你的鲁莽大意，竟给我们套上了这道绞索？

sentences.en: Jacobs claimed the accident was not his fault, stating that he had sighted surf spray breaking against the reef from a distance, but the ship's
sentences.zh: 雅各布斯声称事故不是他的错，说他曾在远处看到礁石上泛起的浪花，但船上的

sentences.en: lookout insisted it was nothing more than the moon's reflection on the water.
sentences.zh: 瞭望员坚称那不过是月光在水面上的倒影。

sentences.en: As it was unclear whether the tide was high or low, the crew wondered whether they might have simply run aground in shallows and
sentences.zh: 由于分不清当时是涨潮还是落潮，船员们纳闷他们是否只是在浅滩上搁浅了，

sentences.en: would be able to float back out to sea once the water level rose.
sentences.zh: 等水位上升后就能重新浮回海中。

sentences.en: But after waiting several hours, it became clear that the collision had taken place at high tide.
sentences.zh: 但在等待了几个小时后，情况变得明朗起来，撞击发生时正是涨潮时分。

sentences.en: Falling water levels revealed they were surrounded by rocks, reefs and small islands.
sentences.zh: 下降的水位显示，他们四周环绕着岩石、暗礁和小岛。

sentences.en: The impact had careened the ship half out of the ocean with sharp coral tearing away its rudder and gouging its timber sides.
sentences.zh: 撞击产生的冲力将船身的一半冲出了海面，锋利的珊瑚撕裂了船舵，并在木质船舷上刮出深深的沟壑。

sentences.en: Several frightened individuals jumped overboard and either drowned or were pierced by the sharp coral below.
sentences.zh: 几个惊恐的人跳进海里，要么溺水身亡，要么被水下锋利的珊瑚刺穿。

sentences.en: The crew began discarding cannons and gunners to lighten the Batavia's load, and just after dawn, they cut its main mast down as well.
sentences.zh: 为了减轻巴达维亚号的载重，船员们开始丢弃大炮和炮手，拂晓刚过，他们甚至砍掉了主桅杆。

sentences.en: Historians would later determine that the Batavia struck a shoal called Morning Reef in the northernmost cluster of the Abrolhos, a network of 122 barren, windswept islands and
sentences.zh: 历史学家后来确定，巴达维亚号撞上的是阿布罗略斯群岛最北端的一处名为晨礁的浅滩，该群岛由122个贫瘠、多风的岛屿以及

sentences.en: associated coral reefs in the Indian Ocean.
sentences.zh: 印度洋中相关的珊瑚礁网络组成。

sentences.en: They are located roughly 60 kilometres west of what is today the city of Geraldton in Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 它们位于当今西澳大利亚州杰拉尔顿市以西约60公里处。

sentences.en: There are three distinct groups of islands, all of which have little in the way of vegetation or wildlife aside from a few sea lions and birds.
sentences.zh: 这里有三个截然不同的岛屿群，除了几只海狮和鸟类之外，几乎没有什么植被或野生动物。

sentences.en: Seven hours after the collision, as preparations were underway to safely relocate Batavia's passengers, the ship burst open
sentences.zh: 撞击发生七小时后，正当人们准备安全转移巴达维亚号的乘客时，船体

sentences.en: below the waterline and its hold began filling with water.
sentences.zh: 在水线以下突然破裂，船舱开始进水。

sentences.en: The ship's crew began rowing the passengers away in the Batavia's longboat, an open vessel capable of holding 40 people, and its yawl, a sailboat that could carry 23.
sentences.zh: 船员们开始用巴达维亚号的长艇（一种可容纳40人的开放式船只）和平底帆船（可搭载23人）将乘客划走。

sentences.en: They were set down on an island about two kilometres from the shipwreck.
sentences.zh: 他们被安置在距离沉船约两公里的一座岛屿上。

sentences.en: It was a tiny, hard and flat landmass with no vegetation, sand or shelter.
sentences.zh: 那是一片极小、坚硬且平坦的陆地，没有植被、沙子或庇护所。

sentences.en: Broken and sharp coral pieces lay all over the ground, making it difficult to walk on.
sentences.zh: 地上到处都是破碎而锋利的珊瑚碎片，让人很难行走。

sentences.en: By dusk, a number of people had been transferred to the island, including all of the women and children.
sentences.zh: 到了黄昏，许多人已被转移到该岛，包括所有的妇女和儿童。

sentences.en: 150 pints of drinking water, barrels of wine, meat and bread, and a casket full of valuable trade goods such as jewellery, gold and precious stones were also transported to land.
sentences.zh: 150品脱饮用水、几桶葡萄酒、肉和面包，以及装满珠宝、黄金和宝石等珍贵贸易物资的小箱子也被运到了岸上。

sentences.en: Rescue work paused at night when it became too dark to see.
sentences.zh: 天黑得看不清东西时，救援工作被迫暂停。

sentences.en: Roughly 120 people still remained on the slowly crumbling Batavia.
sentences.zh: 大约还有120人留在缓慢解体的巴达维亚号上。

sentences.en: At dawn the following morning, efforts to retrieve those still stranded on the Batavia recommenced.
sentences.zh: 次日拂晓，搜救仍然被困在巴达维亚号上的人员的工作重新开始。

sentences.en: The small island closest to the ship became overcrowded, so 180 men, women and children were moved to a larger landmass roughly
sentences.zh: 离船最近的小岛变得拥挤不堪，于是180名男子、妇女和儿童被转移到了一处较大的陆地，大约

sentences.en: 800 metres away that had a sandy beach.
sentences.zh: 800米外，那里有一片沙滩。

sentences.en: They were given a limited supply of food, while Commander Pelsart,
sentences.zh: 他们只分到了有限的食物，而佩尔萨特指挥官、

sentences.en: Captain Jacobs, all of the senior VOC company officials, a number of sailors, two women and one infant, remained on the smaller island with the longboat and yaw.
sentences.zh: 雅各布斯船长、所有VOC公司的高级官员、数名水手、两名妇女和一个婴儿，则和长艇以及平底帆船一起留在了那个较小的岛上。

sentences.en: Commander Pelsart was convinced to travel to the Australian mainland to find supplies.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特指挥官被说服前往澳大利亚大陆寻找补给。

sentences.en: As the journey would require a couple of days preparation, he opted to explore other nearby islands in the meantime.
sentences.zh: 由于这一旅程需要几天时间的准备，他决定在此期间探索其他附近的岛屿。

sentences.en: Before departing on their expedition, Pelsart and some of his companions rode over to the larger island where the majority of
sentences.zh: 在踏上探险之旅前，佩尔萨特和他的几位同伴乘船前往较大的岛屿——大多数

sentences.en: survivors were now stationed to give them a barrel of drinking water and explain their plans.
sentences.zh: 幸存者现在驻扎在那里，给他们送去一桶饮用水并解释他们的计划。

sentences.en: As they approached, the survivors gathered together on the shoreline.
sentences.zh: 当他们靠近时，幸存者们聚集在海岸线上。

sentences.en: Fearful that they would be mobbed and prevented from leaving, the men rowing refused to stop and wouldn't allow Pelsart to deliver the water.
sentences.zh: 由于担心被暴民围攻而无法离开，划船的人拒绝停船，也不允许佩尔萨特去送水。

sentences.en: Pelsart continued north to inspect the two largest islands in their vicinity, where he dug for water but found none.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特继续向北去查看他们附近最大的两个岛屿，在那里他掘地找水，但一无所获。

sentences.en: He returned to his camp on the small inlet nearest the Batavia and on June 8th, four days after the shipwreck, departed for the Australian mainland.
sentences.zh: 他回到了距离“巴达维亚”号最近的小海湾的营地，并于 6 月 8 日（即船难发生四天后）出发前往澳大利亚大陆。

sentences.en: He left behind a note explaining his actions and ordered his crewmen to sign an oath confirming that their mission was to search for water.
sentences.zh: 他留下了一张便条解释自己的行为，并命令船员签署一份宣誓书，确认他们的任务是寻找水源。

sentences.en: They set sail in Batavia's longboat with the smaller yawl tied to the back.
sentences.zh: 他们乘坐“巴达维亚”号的长艇起航，后面拖着较小的单桅小艇。

sentences.en: The longboat was designed to carry 40 people, but as no one from Pelsart's island wanted to be left behind, it held 48 in total.
sentences.zh: 长艇原本设计搭载 40 人，但由于佩尔萨特岛上没有人想被留下，总共挤了 48 人。

sentences.en: They left all the ship's recovered jewels and coins behind.
sentences.zh: 他们把船上捞上来的所有珠宝和硬币都留在了原地。

sentences.en: The group sailed north along the
sentences.zh: 这群人沿着

sentences.en: Western Australian coaSt. The barren land was framed by jagged cliffs that soared up to 228 metres high.
sentences.zh: 西澳大利亚海岸向北航行。贫瘠的土地被高耸达 228 米的陡峭悬崖环绕。

sentences.en: On several occasions, they managed to row to a shoreline and succeeded in collecting rainwater, but never found a permanent fresh water supply.
sentences.zh: 他们曾数次设法划船靠岸并成功收集到雨水，但从未找到稳定的淡水供应。

sentences.en: After sailing for a week without success, it was decided that they should continue on to their original destination of Batavia in Indonesia to seek rescue assistance from the VOC.
sentences.zh: 在毫无收获地航行了一周后，大家决定继续前往他们最初的目的地印度尼西亚的巴达维亚，向荷兰东印度公司（VOC）寻求救援协助。

sentences.en: Upon learning of Commander Pelsart's departure, the near 200 survivors on the Big Island were left devastated.
sentences.zh: 得知佩尔萨特指挥官离开后，大岛上近 200 名幸存者感到心碎欲绝。

sentences.en: They accused their leader of abandoning them and dubbed the small inlet where Pelsart had camped, Traitor's Island.
sentences.zh: 他们指责领袖抛弃了他们，并将佩尔萨特扎营的小海湾命名为“叛徒岛”。

sentences.en: Their own island, which measured 270 metres wide and half a kilometre long, was named Batavia's Graveyard.
sentences.zh: 他们自己的岛屿宽 270 米，长半公里，被命名为“巴达维亚的墓地”。

sentences.en: Historian Mike Dash described it as a strip of coral rubble, where the only living thing was the wind.
sentences.zh: 历史学家迈克·达什将其描述为一条珊瑚碎石带，那里唯一的生物只有风。

sentences.en: The shipwreck survivors landed there at the beginning of the Southern Hemisphere's winter, which regularly battered the area with storms and fierce gales.
sentences.zh: 船难幸存者在南半球冬季开始时登陆该岛，该地区经常遭到风暴和狂风的袭击。

sentences.en: Of those stranded on Batavia's graveyard, at least 100 were VOC soldiers or sailors,
sentences.zh: 在困在巴达维亚墓地的人中，至少有 100 名荷兰东印度公司士兵或水手，

sentences.en: while more than a dozen others were men with trade experience such as carpenters and blacksmiths.
sentences.zh: 另有十多名拥有木匠和铁匠等手艺经验的人。

sentences.en: There were 21 women, the majority of whom were wives of the crew, a number of teenagers and children, and two infants who were born during the voyage.
sentences.zh: 这里有 21 名女性，其中大多数是船员的妻子，还有许多青少年和儿童，以及两名在航行期间出生的婴儿。

sentences.en: Most of the population's food and water supplies were depleted within a day, and anxieties only increased when Commander Pelsart sailed away with the other VOC officials.
sentences.zh: 大多数人口的食物和水供应在一天内就耗尽了，而当佩尔萨特指挥官与其他东印度公司官员乘船离开时，焦虑感更是有增无减。

sentences.en: Some survivors were driven to drinking seawater or their own urine, while 10 people died from dehydration.
sentences.zh: 一些幸存者被迫饮用海水或自己的尿液，同时有 10 人因脱水身亡。

sentences.en: It finally rained on the sixth and seventh days of their ordeal, allowing them to collect a valuable drinking water.
sentences.zh: 灾难发生的第六天和第七天终于下雨了，让他们收集到了宝贵的饮用水。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, 70 men had chosen to stay on the Batavia, including mutineer Euronymous Cornelius.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，有 70 人选择留在“巴达维亚”号上，其中包括叛变者尤罗尼穆斯·科内利斯。

sentences.en: They pillaged supplies and helped themselves to food and alcohol.
sentences.zh: 他们掠夺了物资，自顾自地享用食物和酒精。

sentences.en: When the ships started flooding and breaking apart, it became harder and harder for them to find safe, dry places.
sentences.zh: 当船开始进水并解体时，他们越来越难找到安全、干燥的地方。

sentences.en: Some jumped overboard, attempting to either float or swim to safety.
sentences.zh: 有些人跳海，试图漂浮或游到安全地带。

sentences.en: Most failed, with 40 people drowning as a result.
sentences.zh: 大多数人失败了，导致 40 人溺水身亡。

sentences.en: On June 12, one week after the collision, the ship collapsed completely.
sentences.zh: 6 月 12 日，即撞船一周后，船彻底垮塌了。

sentences.en: Just as its hull started disintegrating, Cornelius jumped from the deck and grasped onto a pole from a mast that had already landed in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 就在船体开始解体时，科内利斯从甲板上跳下，抓住了一根已经落入海中的桅杆杆子。

sentences.en: Clutching it, he floated towards the shallows, spending two days in the water before reaching Batavia's graveyard.
sentences.zh: 他紧紧抓着它，漂向浅滩，在水中呆了两天后才到达巴达维亚墓地。

sentences.en: By this time, the survivors had created a functioning camp on the northeast portion of the island.
sentences.zh: 此时，幸存者已经在岛屿东北部建立了一个功能齐备的营地。

sentences.en: As the ship collapsed, more supplies and useful wreckage kept washing up.
sentences.zh: 随着船体垮塌，更多的物资和有用的残骸不断被冲上岸。

sentences.en: Tents were crafted from canvas and mast poles, driftwood was used for fires, and barrels of wine, water, and vinegar had also been recovered.
sentences.zh: 帐篷是用帆布和桅杆杆子搭建的，漂流木用来生火，人们还找回了桶装的葡萄酒、水和醋。

sentences.en: The survivors hunted sea lions and birds for food, decimating the wildlife population within a week.
sentences.zh: 幸存者捕杀海狮和鸟类充饥，在一周内就使当地的野生动物数量锐减。

sentences.en: Cornelius was taken to a dry area, given a meal and a change of clothes, as well as a bed to sleep in.
sentences.zh: 科内利斯被带到一个干燥的地区，吃了一顿饭，换了身衣服，并有一张床供他睡觉。

sentences.en: Prior to his arrival, a small council had been established, tasked with governing the island's population.
sentences.zh: 在他到达之前，已经成立了一个小型委员会，负责管理岛上的人口。

sentences.en: The role of council leader was initially given to the only survivor with any semblance of rank, a surgeon who was popular with the ship's crew, but lacked experience in command.
sentences.zh: 委员会领袖的角色最初交给了唯一具有某种军阶的幸存者——一名在船员中很受欢迎但缺乏指挥经验的外科医生。

sentences.en: As Commander Pelsart's deputy, Cornelius had a rank and status that no one else present could claim, and he was immediately elected to lead the council.
sentences.zh: 作为佩尔萨特指挥官的副手，科内利斯拥有在场其他人无法企及的军阶和地位，他立即被推选为委员会领导人。

sentences.en: Cornelius enjoyed the authority he was granted, but was concerned that the large number of survivors would drain the island's resources and become a threat to his own survival.
sentences.zh: 科内利斯很享受被授予的权力，但也担心庞大的幸存者人数会耗尽岛上的资源，成为他自己生存的威胁。

sentences.en: His worries increased when one of the young men who had been recruited for the intended mutiny on the Batavia started revealing details of the plot to others
sentences.zh: 当其中一名曾被招募参与“巴达维亚”号预谋哗变的年轻人开始向其他人透露该计划的细节时，他的担忧加剧了，

sentences.en: because he was angry Captain Jakobs left him behind.
sentences.zh: 因为他愤怒于雅各布斯船长抛弃了他。

sentences.en: He didn't share that Cornelius had also been involved, but Cornelius was unnerved nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 他没有说科内利斯也参与其中，但科内利斯依然感到不安。

sentences.en: If word spread that he had been part of a scheme to seize control of a VOC ship, there was a chance he would be arrested and tried for treason when help arrived.
sentences.zh: 如果有消息传出他曾参与夺取一艘东印度公司船只的计划，一旦救援到来，他很有可能会被逮捕并因叛国罪受审。

sentences.en: As such, Cornelius began plotting another mutiny.
sentences.zh: 因此，科内利斯开始策划另一次哗变。

sentences.en: He believed that if he had a group of loyal supporters, he would be able to overpower any rescuers and commandeer their vessel to assume a life of piracy.
sentences.zh: 他相信，如果他有一群忠诚的支持者，他就能够制服任何救援人员并夺取他们的船只，从而过上海盗的生活。

sentences.en: He was known to be a charismatic and well-spoken individual, and by late June he had
sentences.zh: 众所周知，他是一个富有个人魅力且口才极佳的人，到了 6 月下旬，他

sentences.en: successfully recruited two dozen men, including some of the original mutineers as well as army cadets.
sentences.zh: 已经成功招募了二十多名男子，其中包括一些最初的哗变者以及陆军学员。

sentences.en: He then stockpiled all of the swords, daggers and muskets that had been saved from the ship, keeping them in a single storage area that he controlled.
sentences.zh: 随后，他将从船上救出的所有剑、匕首和火枪囤积起来，存放在他控制的一个储藏区内。

sentences.en: He sent some of his men out on scouting missions to other islands to determine whether survival elsewhere would be possible.
sentences.zh: 他派他的一些手下去其他岛屿进行侦察任务，以确定在其他地方生存是否可行。

sentences.en: Using boats crafted from the ship's wreckage, the men inspected several islands, including the two large ones Commander Pelsart had already visited, which were given the
sentences.zh: 利用从船只残骸中制作的船只，这些人视察了几个岛屿，包括佩尔萨特指挥官已经访问过的两个大岛，

sentences.en: collective name of the Highland due to a hill that rose from the smaller of the two.
sentences.zh: 由于其中较小的岛屿上有一座小山，它们被统称为“高原”。

sentences.en: They found no drinking water and little in the way of food.
sentences.zh: 他们没有找到饮用水，食物也很少。

sentences.en: Despite this, Cornelius proclaimed that his men had discovered decent resources elsewhere and announced that some people would
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，科内利斯还是宣称他的手下在别处发现了不错的资源，并宣布有些人将被

sentences.en: be moved to other islands so that Batavia's graveyard wouldn't be overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 转移到其他岛屿，以免巴达维亚墓地不堪重负。

sentences.en: He promised that their supplies would be replenished as needed.
sentences.zh: 他承诺会根据需要补充他们的物资。

sentences.en: Forty men, women and children were transported to an island to the west, dubbed Seals Island.
sentences.zh: 四十名男女老少被转移到了西边的一个岛屿，被称为海豹岛。

sentences.en: Fifteen others were sent to the small inlet that once harboured Commander Pelsart and the other VOC officials, Traders Island.
sentences.zh: 另外十五人被派往曾庇护佩尔萨特指挥官和其他东印度公司官员的小海湾——叛徒岛。

sentences.en: Then, Cornelius announced that a third group comprised of twenty soldiers would also be sent away to source drinking water from the Highland.
sentences.zh: 随后，科内利斯宣布，由二十名士兵组成的第三组也将被送往高原寻找饮用水。

sentences.en: He told the soldiers to send smoke signals once they found water and someone would come to collect them.
sentences.zh: 他告诉士兵们一旦找到水源就发出烟雾信号，会有人来接他们。

sentences.en: In actual fact, his plan was to remove the most threatening soldiers who were loyal to the VOC by marooning them on the islands that were furthest away.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他的计划是将那些效忠于东印度公司、最具威胁性的士兵流放到最远的岛屿上，以此除掉他们。

sentences.en: By dispatching these three groups,
sentences.zh: 通过派遣这三组人员，

sentences.en: Cornelius successfully cut the population of Batavia's graveyard by a third and removed nearly four dozen strong, able-bodied men from his island.
sentences.zh: 科内利斯成功地将巴达维亚墓地的人口削减了三分之一，并从他的岛上移走了近四打身强力壮的男子。

sentences.en: Cornelius' next plan was to overhaul the council, as other members could vote against any of his decisions that they didn't agree with.
sentences.zh: 科内利斯的下一个计划是改组委员会，因为其他成员可能会对他的任何不同意决定投反对票。

sentences.en: An opportunity arose on July 4, exactly one month after the Batavia struck the reef.
sentences.zh: 7 月 4 日，即“巴达维亚”号触礁正好一个月之际，机会来了。

sentences.en: Cornelius was informed that a soldier had been stealing wine from a storage tent and sharing it with a friend.
sentences.zh: 有人向科内利斯报告说，一名士兵一直在储藏帐篷里偷酒，并与朋友分享。

sentences.en: Although the involvement of the second accused was difficult to prove, Cornelius sentenced both men to die, knowing his fellow councillors would object.
sentences.zh: 尽管第二名被指控者的参与很难证明，但科内利斯还是判处两人死刑，明知他的同僚委员们会反对。

sentences.en: In response to their outcry, he dissolved the council, gaining absolute power over the 130 plus people on Batavia's graveyard.
sentences.zh: 面对他们的抗议，他解散了委员会，获得了对巴达维亚墓地上 130 多人的绝对权力。

sentences.en: The next day,
sentences.zh: 第二天，

sentences.en: Cornelius replaced the ousted council members with three of his most loyal followers.
sentences.zh: 科内利斯用他三个最忠实的追随者取代了被罢免的委员会成员。

sentences.en: Their first act was to carry out the execution of the two wine thieves.
sentences.zh: 他们的第一项行动就是处决这两名偷酒贼。

sentences.en: The soldier was killed, but his friend's fate is unknown, with some speculating that he escaped to another island.
sentences.zh: 这名士兵被杀，但他朋友的命运未知，有人猜测他逃到了另一个岛上。

sentences.en: That same day, Cornelius accused two carpenters of planning to sail away on a makeshift raft.
sentences.zh: 同一天，科内利斯指控两名木匠密谋乘自制木筏逃跑。

sentences.en: Within hours, both men were executed by two of Cornelius' mutineers.
sentences.zh: 几小时内，两人就被科内利斯的两名叛变者处决了。

sentences.en: One later boasted that his sword went through his victim, quote, as easily as butter.
sentences.zh: 其中一人后来吹嘘说，他的剑刺穿受害者，原话是“就像切黄油一样容易”。

sentences.en: Cornelius ordered the killings under the guise of law enforcement, as he was vastly outnumbered by the island's population and couldn't risk an uprising.
sentences.zh: 科内利斯以执法为借口下令杀戮，因为岛上人口众多，他在人数上处于绝对劣势，冒不起爆发起义的风险。

sentences.en: Days passed, and the soldiers sent to the highland in search of resources had yet to release any smoke signals.
sentences.zh: 日子一天天过去，被派往高地寻找物资的士兵们却迟迟没有释放任何烟雾信号。

sentences.en: Cornelius declared that several parties of three to four individuals would be dispatched to assist them.
sentences.zh: 科尼利乌斯宣布，将分批派遣三到四人的小组前去协助他们。

sentences.en: The first group, consisting of two soldiers and two sailors, were escorted to the highland via boat by David Zevunk, a member of Cornelius' handpicked council.
sentences.zh: 第一组由两名士兵和两名水手组成，在科尼利乌斯亲自挑选的委员会成员大卫·泽文克的护送下，乘船前往高地。

sentences.en: As soon as they were out of sight, Zevunk and his crew of six mutineers launched an attack.
sentences.zh: 他们刚一驶出视线，泽文克和他的六名叛变同伙便发动了袭击。

sentences.en: They bound three of their passengers by the wrists and ankles, then threw them overboard.
sentences.zh: 他们将其中三名乘客的手脚绑起来，然后扔进了海里。

sentences.en: The remaining passenger was given mercy on the condition he swear allegiance to Cornelius.
sentences.zh: 剩下的那名乘客因发誓效忠科尼利乌斯而饶过一命。

sentences.en: Two days later, the same trap was used again to drown two more men.
sentences.zh: 两天后，同样的陷阱再次被用来淹死了另外两个人。

sentences.en: Hans Hardens had been travelling on the Batavia with his wife Anakin and their six-year-old daughter Hilatrine.
sentences.zh: 汉斯·哈登斯此前携妻子阿纳金和六岁的女儿希拉特琳搭乘“巴达维亚”号出行。

sentences.en: He had submitted to Cornelius, likely to ensure provisions for his family.
sentences.zh: 他向科尼利乌斯屈服了，这很可能是为了确保家人的口粮。

sentences.en: Uncertain as to whether he could trust Hans, Cornelius carried out a test of his loyalty.
sentences.zh: 由于不确定是否能信任汉斯，科尼利乌斯对他的忠诚进行了测试。

sentences.en: On July 8, he invited Hans and his wife to join him for a meal in his private tent.
sentences.zh: 7月8日，他邀请汉斯和妻子到他的私人帐篷里共进晚餐。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a mutineer crept into the Hardens' family tent and strangled six-year-old Hilatrine to death.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一名叛变者悄悄溜进哈登斯一家的帐篷，将六岁的希拉特琳勒死。

sentences.en: She was one of nine people who had been murdered under Cornelius' rule so far, and afterwards, Hans Hardens signed a loyalty oath to the mutineers.
sentences.zh: 她是科尼利乌斯统治下迄今为止遇害的九人之一，事后，汉斯·哈登斯签署了效忠叛变者的誓言。

sentences.en: Private Webby Hayes was leading the soldiers searching for resources on the highland.
sentences.zh: 韦比·海斯下士当时正率领士兵在高地上寻找物资。

sentences.en: Little is known of his background, but he was a skilled fighter and a natural leader.
sentences.zh: 人们对他的背景知之甚少，但他是一名技艺高超的战斗员，也是个天生的领袖。

sentences.en: The group found nothing substantial on the smaller of the two islands.
sentences.zh: 这群人在两座岛中较小的那座上没有找到任何实质性的东西。

sentences.en: After several days, they explored the second, larger island.
sentences.zh: 几天后，他们探索了第二座较大的岛屿。

sentences.en: It was separated from the first by a one and a half kilometre sandbank that appeared at low tide.
sentences.zh: 它与第一座岛被一条一点五公里长的沙洲隔开，沙洲在退潮时才会出现。

sentences.en: This island was far more abundant in wildlife than any of the others the survivors had encountered.
sentences.zh: 这座岛上的野生动植物比幸存者们遇到过的任何其他岛屿都要丰富得多。

sentences.en: It was populated by wallabies, snakes and birds, and there were numerous fishing spots.
sentences.zh: 这里栖息着小袋鼠、蛇和鸟类，还有许多钓鱼点。

sentences.en: But they struggled to find a fresh water supply.
sentences.zh: 但他们很难找到淡水水源。

sentences.en: Subsisting on rainwater, birds' eggs, wallabies and fish, they explored the area more thoroughly than any of the earlier groups had done.
sentences.zh: 他们靠雨水、鸟蛋、小袋鼠和鱼类维生，对该地区的探索比以往任何小组都要彻底。

sentences.en: On July 9, they discovered two natural wells hidden beneath slabs of limestone, a sedimentary rock that typically forms in shallow marine waters.
sentences.zh: 7月9日，他们在通常形成于浅海的沉积岩——石灰岩板下方发现了两个天然水井。

sentences.en: One of the wells was three metres deep and full of fresh water.
sentences.zh: 其中一口水井深三米，里面装满了淡水。

sentences.en: They hastily lit three fires to alert the survivors to the south of their crucial discovery.
sentences.zh: 他们匆忙点燃三处篝火，向南部的幸存者发出他们这一重大发现的信号。

sentences.en: The 15 people stationed on Traders Island noticed the smoke signals right away.
sentences.zh: 驻扎在商人岛上的15人立刻注意到了烟雾信号。

sentences.en: They quickly boarded their two makeshift boats and began rowing towards the highland.
sentences.zh: 他们迅速登上两艘简易船只，开始向高地划去。

sentences.en: On Batavia's graveyard, Cornelius initially ignored the smoke signals, until he noticed the two Traders Island boats heading in their direction.
sentences.zh: 在巴达维亚墓地，科尼利乌斯起初忽视了烟雾信号，直到他注意到两艘商人岛的船只正朝他们的方向驶来。

sentences.en: He ordered his men to attack, and two of his most trusted followers, David Zavunk and Cornrat Vanhuyssen, jumped into a boat with five other mutineers to pursue them.
sentences.zh: 他命令手下发起进攻，他最信任的两个追随者大卫·扎文克和康拉特·范赫森带着其他五名叛变者跳上一艘船去追击他们。

sentences.en: They caught up to the Traders Island survivors and ordered them to stop, before boarding their vessels.
sentences.zh: 他们追上了商人岛的幸存者，命令他们停下，然后登上了他们的船只。

sentences.en: The passengers, consisting mostly of soldiers and sailors, but also three women and two children, were forced to surrender.
sentences.zh: 船上的乘客大多是士兵和水手，还有三名妇女和两名儿童，他们被迫投降。

sentences.en: Several jumped into the ocean to escape, only to drown.
sentences.zh: 几个人跳进海里逃生，结果却淹死了。

sentences.en: The rest were taken back to Batavia's graveyard.
sentences.zh: 其余的人被带回了巴达维亚墓地。

sentences.en: David Zavunk raced over to consult with Cornelius.
sentences.zh: 大卫·扎文克赶忙跑去与科尼利乌斯商议。

sentences.en: He then ran back towards the shallows where the captives were being held, crying out,
sentences.zh: 随后他又跑回关押俘虏的浅水区，大喊道：

sentences.en: Kill.
sentences.zh: 杀。

sentences.en: Cornelius's men stabbed both children and all of the men, before rowing the three women out to sea and throwing them overboard.
sentences.zh: 科尼利乌斯的手下刺死了两个孩子和所有的男人，然后将这三名妇女划到海里并把她们扔了下去。

sentences.en: The massacre took place in full view of witnesses, making it the first time that many of the survivors realised the true nature of the man who was leading them.
sentences.zh: 这场屠杀是在众目睽睽之下进行的，这也是许多幸存者第一次认清了领导他们的这个男人的真正本性。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案卷节目稍后回归。
