sentences.en: In the days following the slaughter of the residents of Traders Island, roughly a dozen more men declared their loyalty to Cornelius.
sentences.zh: 在屠杀商人岛居民后的几天里，大约又有十几名男子宣布效忠科尼利乌斯。

sentences.en: The most violent mutineers, emboldened after committing a public massacre, regularly tormented others by taking their belongings and threatening them.
sentences.zh: 那些最暴力的叛变者在公开屠杀后胆子大了起来，经常通过抢夺他人财物和威胁他人来折磨别人。

sentences.en: The bloodshed continued, and people lived in fear of inadvertently drawing attention to themselves.
sentences.zh: 流血事件仍在继续，人们生活在对无意中引起注意的恐惧之中。

sentences.en: Eleven survivors were suffering from illnesses such as scurvy or fever and had been isolated to a communal tent.
sentences.zh: 有十一名幸存者患有坏血病或发烧等疾病，已被隔离在一个公共帐篷里。

sentences.en: Cornelius felt those in poor health were draining the island's resources.
sentences.zh: 科尼利乌斯觉得那些身体不好的人在消耗岛上的资源。

sentences.en: On July 10, a mutineer following his orders entered the quarantine tent late at night and slit the throats of everyone inside.
sentences.zh: 7月10日，一名听从他命令的叛变者深夜潜入隔离帐篷，割断了里面所有人的喉咙。

sentences.en: From that point on, it became extremely dangerous for anyone other than the mutineers to fall sick.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，除了叛变者之外，任何人生病都变得极其危险。

sentences.en: Over time, more and more ill people were murdered, commonly at night when they were at their most vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，越来越多生病的人被谋杀，通常是在他们最脆弱的夜间。

sentences.en: By July 14, less than two weeks after the murders started, the mutineers had killed nearly 50 survivors, lowering the population of
sentences.zh: 到7月14日，即谋杀开始不到两周后，叛变者已经杀害了近50名幸存者，将

sentences.en: Batavia's Graveyard to around 90.
sentences.zh: 巴达维亚墓地的人口降至约90人。

sentences.en: Those residing on the Highland and Seals Island lived in relative safety out of reach, though it wasn't long before Cornelius turned his attention to them.
sentences.zh: 居住在高地和海豹岛的人们在触及不到的安全地带过着相对安稳的生活，不过没过多久，科尼利乌斯就把注意力转向了他们。

sentences.en: On July 15, Cornelius ordered seven mutineers to kill all the male inhabitants of Seals Island.
sentences.zh: 7月15日，科尼利乌斯命令七名叛变者杀死海豹岛上的所有男性居民。

sentences.en: As well as being armed with swords and daggers, the mutineers had crafted weapons called Mourning
sentences.zh: 除了配备剑和匕首，叛变者还制作了名为晨曦

sentences.en: Stars, which typically consisted of a spiked ball at the end of a chain attached to a piece of wood.
sentences.zh: 之星的武器，这通常由一根木头上连着一条链子，链子末端挂着一个带刺的铁球组成。

sentences.en: The mutineers' version consisted of half-bent strips of lead with long nails attached.
sentences.zh: 叛变者的版本是由带长钉的半弯曲铅条组成的。

sentences.en: Rope was tied to one end so they could be swung at victims' heads.
sentences.zh: 一端系有绳子，这样就可以朝着受害者的头部挥舞。

sentences.en: Leading the attack were Cornelius' chief executioners, David Zayvunk and Cornrat Van
sentences.zh: 带头攻击的是科尼利乌斯的首席刽子手大卫·扎伊文克和康拉特·范

sentences.en: Hyssen.
sentences.zh: 海森。

sentences.en: As soon as they landed on Seals Island, four men and six boys were stabbed and killed.
sentences.zh: 他们刚在海豹岛登陆，就有四名男子和六名男孩被刺身亡。

sentences.en: Those who were wounded were dragged to the shore to be drowned.
sentences.zh: 受伤的人被拖到岸边淹死。

sentences.en: Fifteen cabin boys managed to outrun the mutineers and hide.
sentences.zh: 十五名船舱服务生设法跑过叛变者并藏了起来。

sentences.en: The four female inhabitants, as per Cornelius' instruction, were spared.
sentences.zh: 根据科尔内利的指示，四名女性居民幸免于难。

sentences.en: Eight men escaped to the Highland using boats they had crafted in a secluded area of the island.
sentences.zh: 八名男子利用他们在岛上偏僻地区制作的船只逃到了高地。

sentences.en: After slaughtering half of Seals Island's population, the mutineers returned to Batavia's graveyard.
sentences.zh: 在屠杀了一半的海豹岛人口后，叛变者回到了巴达维亚的墓地。

sentences.en: Three days later, on July 18, Cornelius ordered his men to return to Seals Island after dark and finish the job.
sentences.zh: 三天后的7月18日，科尔内利命令手下天黑后返回海豹岛完成任务。

sentences.en: Upon arrival, Zayvunk handed a mutineer his knife and instructed him to kill the four women.
sentences.zh: 抵达后，扎伊文克递给一名叛变者一把刀，并指示他杀死这四名妇女。

sentences.en: Without hesitation, the mutineer went to a heavily pregnant woman named Mikan Source, took her by the hand and said,
sentences.zh: 叛变者毫不犹豫地走到一个怀有身孕的妇女Mikan Source面前，拉起她的手说：

sentences.en: Mike and Love, you must die, before throwing her down and cutting her throat.
sentences.zh: 迈克和爱，你们必须死，随后将她摔倒并割断了她的喉咙。

sentences.en: The other three women were also murdered.
sentences.zh: 另外三名女性也被谋杀。

sentences.en: Twelve of the cabin boys were stabbed and bludgeoned.
sentences.zh: 十二名船舱服务生被刺伤并殴打致死。

sentences.en: Those who didn't die immediately were drowned at sea.
sentences.zh: 那些没有立即死亡的人被淹死在海里。

sentences.en: Three boys survived by running away and hiding in bushes.
sentences.zh: 三名男孩通过逃跑并藏在灌木丛中幸存下来。

sentences.en: They were safe until almost a week later on July 24, when they emerged in sight of Batavia's graveyard.
sentences.zh: 他们一直很安全，直到近一周后的7月24日，当他们出现在巴达维亚墓地的视线中时。

sentences.en: Cornelius saw them and sent men to capture them.
sentences.zh: 科尔内利看到了他们，并派人去抓捕他们。

sentences.en: They were forced onto a boat, with one of the boys made to throw the other two overboard to drown.
sentences.zh: 他们被强行带上一艘船，其中一个男孩被迫将另外两个抛入海中淹死。

sentences.en: He was permitted to live in exchange for becoming a mutineer.
sentences.zh: 作为成为叛变者的交换，他被允许活下来。

sentences.en: Towards the end of July,
sentences.zh: 七月底左右，

sentences.en: Cornelius ordered increasingly violent and shocking deaths.
sentences.zh: 科尔内利下令进行越来越暴力和令人震惊的杀戮。

sentences.en: In one instance, he became enraged by a sick baby girl who cried constantly at night.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他被一个晚上哭个不停生病的小女孩惹恼了。

sentences.en: As a former pharmacist, he offered the child's mother a medicine he'd mixed, claiming it would help.
sentences.zh: 作为前药剂师，他给孩子的母亲提供了一种他混合的药，声称会有帮助。

sentences.en: This would be the only time he attempted to kill someone by his own hands.
sentences.zh: 这将是他唯一一次试图亲手杀人。

sentences.en: After consuming the concoction, the baby entered a comatose state but didn't die.
sentences.zh: 服用了这种混合剂后，婴儿进入了昏迷状态，但没有死。

sentences.en: The following night, Cornelius had a mutineer strangle her.
sentences.zh: 第二天晚上，科尔内利让一名叛变者勒死了她。

sentences.en: Cornelius' egomania went unchecked.
sentences.zh: 科尔内利的自大狂变得无法无天。

sentences.en: He wore Commander Francisco Pelsart's expensive clothes and would change outfits multiple times a day.
sentences.zh: 他穿着指挥官弗朗西斯科·佩尔萨特的昂贵衣服，一天要换好几套衣服。

sentences.en: His most trusted followers were also given special outfits made from expensive, high-quality red wool and sewn with elaborate trimmings.
sentences.zh: 他最信任的追随者也获得了用昂贵的高品质红羊毛制成并缝制有精致饰边的特别服装。

sentences.en: They lived better than anybody else on the island, eating cask meat from the ship's rations rather than surviving on birds and sea lions like everyone else.
sentences.zh: 他们的生活比岛上的任何人都要好，吃的是船上口粮中的桶装肉，而不是像其他人那样靠鸟类和海狮生存。

sentences.en: They slept in spacious tents and drank wine instead of rainwater.
sentences.zh: 他们住在宽敞的帐篷里，喝的是葡萄酒而不是雨水。

sentences.en: Mutineers who achieved the highest status were those who could overpower and slaughter other men, while those who killed women and children had a lower ranking.
sentences.zh: 获得最高地位的叛变者是那些能够制服并屠杀其他男人的人，而那些杀死妇女和儿童的人地位较低。

sentences.en: Some mutineers sought a high ranking as a matter of survival and to gain access to rations.
sentences.zh: 一些叛变者为了生存和获得口粮而寻求高地位。

sentences.en: Others were particularly bloodthirsty individuals who enjoyed being able to kill and abuse others without consequence.
sentences.zh: 另一些则是特别嗜血的人，他们喜欢能够毫无后果地杀害和虐待他人。

sentences.en: Guysbert Bastiennes, his wife Maria, and their seven children had managed to survive life on Batavia's graveyard so far, due in part to Guysbert's status as a man of the church.
sentences.zh: 吉斯伯特·巴斯蒂安尼斯、他的妻子玛丽亚和他们的七个孩子迄今为止一直在巴达维亚的墓地上艰难求生，部分原因是因为吉斯伯特具有神职人员的身份。
zh_words: 吉斯伯特·巴斯蒂安尼斯

sentences.en: Guysbert was a minister in the Dutch Reformed Church, known as a predican.
sentences.zh: 吉斯伯特是荷兰归正会的牧师，被称为传道人。

sentences.en: Shortly after the shipwreck,
sentences.zh: 海难发生后不久，

sentences.en: Guysbert's 21-year-old daughter, Judic, caught the attention of one of Cornelius' most violent and cruel henchmen, Cornrat van Heysen.
sentences.zh: 吉斯伯特21岁的女儿朱迪克引起了科尔内利最暴力、最残酷的心腹之一康拉特·范·海森的注意。

sentences.en: He proposed to her on the condition that they consummate their marriage on the island, despite being unable to legally marry until they returned home.
sentences.zh: 他向她求婚，条件是他们必须在岛上圆房，尽管在他们回家之前无法合法结婚。

sentences.en: Judic discussed the issue with her father, and though both were distressed by the offer, they believed her acceptance was the only way to ensure her safety.
sentences.zh: 朱迪克与她的父亲讨论了这个问题，尽管两人都对这个提议感到痛苦，但他们认为她的接受是确保她安全的唯一途径。

sentences.en: So Judic reluctantly agreed to become van Heysen's wife.
sentences.zh: 于是朱迪克不情愿地同意成为范·海森的妻子。

sentences.en: On July 21, Judic and her father were invited to dine with van Heysen and Cornelius.
sentences.zh: 7月21日，朱迪克和她的父亲应邀与范·海森和科尔内利共进晚餐。

sentences.en: While they ate, David Zevunk and eight other mutineers approached the tent where the rest of Guysbert's family were staying.
sentences.zh: 他们吃饭时，大卫·泽温克和其他八名叛变者走近了吉斯伯特其余家人居住的帐篷。

sentences.en: Zevunk called out for the family's maid, and when she approached, he stabbed her.
sentences.zh: 泽温克大声呼叫家里的女佣，当她走近时，他刺伤了她。

sentences.en: He and the others then entered the tent, claiming they were carrying out a search following reports that the family had stolen supplies.
sentences.zh: 他和其余的人随后进入帐篷，声称他们在接到报告称该家族偷窃了物资后正在进行搜查。

sentences.en: After ransacking the tent, they extinguished a hanging lantern and attacked the entire family using a hatchet and an axe.
sentences.zh: 在洗劫了帐篷后，他们熄灭了悬挂的灯笼，并用短柄斧和斧头袭击了全家人。

sentences.en: Maria and six of her children, whose ages ranged from 8 to 23, were killed.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚和她的六个孩子（年龄在8到23岁之间）被杀。

sentences.en: Their bodies were dumped in a mass grave that had been dug earlier that evening.
sentences.zh: 他们的尸体被扔进那天晚上早些时候挖好的万人坑里。

sentences.en: The mutineers continued their rampage throughout the night, killing the VOC's bookkeeper and the mother of the baby Cornelius had poisoned.
sentences.zh: 叛变者整夜继续横行霸道，杀害了VOC的簿记员和科尔内利毒害的婴儿的母亲。

sentences.en: Their bodies were then deposited in the same mass grave that held Guysbert Bastien's family.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们的尸体被安置在装有吉斯伯特·巴斯蒂安家族的同一个万人坑中。

sentences.en: While the massacre was underway, Aris Jantz, a military barber and surgeon who resided on Batavia's graveyard, was set upon by two mutineers armed with swords.
sentences.zh: 大屠杀正在进行时，住在巴达维亚墓地的军事理发师兼外科医生阿里斯·扬茨遭到两名手持剑的叛变者的袭击。

sentences.en: Fortunately, their weapons were blunt, allowing Aris to escape with only minor wounds.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，他们的武器是钝的，这使得阿里斯只受了轻伤就逃脱了。

sentences.en: He dove into the ocean and hid in the dark shallows as the mutineers searched for him.
sentences.zh: 当叛变者搜寻他时，他跳入大海并藏在黑暗的浅滩中。

sentences.en: When they failed to spot Aris, the assailants withdrew back to camp, presuming their victim had succumbed to his injuries.
sentences.zh: 当他们没有发现阿里斯时，袭击者撤回营地，以为他们的受害者已经伤重不治。

sentences.en: After they left, Aris snuck over to the side of the island where the mutineers kept their boats.
sentences.zh: 他们离开后，阿里斯溜到了叛变者藏船的岛屿那一侧。

sentences.en: He boarded one and set sail for the highland.
sentences.zh: 他登上了一艘船，起航前往高地。

sentences.en: When Aris reached the highland, he told Private Webby Hayes and the other soldiers settled there what had been taking place at
sentences.zh: 当阿里斯到达高地时，他告诉列兵韦比·海斯和其他定居在那里的士兵一直在

sentences.en: Batavia's graveyard.
sentences.zh: 巴达维亚的墓地发生的事情。

sentences.en: The island's inhabitants were aware of the atrocities Cornelius and his mutineers had been committing, as many were refugees that had successfully escaped the bloodshed.
sentences.zh: 岛上的居民意识到了科尔内利和他的叛变者一直在犯下的暴行，因为许多人是成功逃脱流血事件的难民。

sentences.en: Since Cornelius came into power, the population of the highland had more than doubled to 45 men and one boy.
sentences.zh: 自从科尔内利掌权以来，高地的人口增加了一倍多，达到45名男子和一个男孩。

sentences.en: In case Cornelius stormed their island, Private Hayes and his men crafted wooden pikes with
sentences.zh: 以防科尔内利突袭他们的岛屿，海斯列兵和他的手下制作了木长矛，

sentences.en: nails hammered into the ends, collected lumps of coral to throw at intruders, and made their own morning stars from wreckage that had washed up.
sentences.zh: 末端敲入钉子，收集珊瑚块扔给入侵者，并用冲上来的残骸制作了他们自己的流星锤。

sentences.en: Hayes had the advantage of being a skilled leader with strong soldiers and a sound understanding of battle tactics.
sentences.zh: 海斯的优势在于他是一名足智多谋的领导者，拥有强大的士兵和对战斗战术的深刻理解。

sentences.en: The only way to access their island was from the neighbouring island's sandbank at low tide, ensuring the mutineers wouldn't be able to launch a surprise attack.
sentences.zh: 进入他们岛屿的唯一途径是在退潮时从邻近岛屿的沙洲进入，这确保了叛变者无法发起偷袭。

sentences.en: Hayes constructed a two-room fort from limestone and coral slabs that overlooked the
sentences.zh: 海斯用石灰石和珊瑚板建造了一个两室堡垒，俯瞰着

sentences.en: sandbank, allowing his men to keep a watch for invaders and take shelter from any potential threat.
sentences.zh: 沙洲，让他的手下能够留意入侵者并躲避任何潜在的威胁。

sentences.en: Two days after the July 21 massacre, Cornelius made a move against those on the highland.
sentences.zh: 在7月21日大屠杀两天后，科尔内利对高地的人采取了行动。

sentences.en: In a seemingly friendly letter addressed to Private Hayes' small militia, Cornelius referred to those
sentences.zh: 在一封写给海斯列兵小型民兵的看似友好的信中，科尔内利提到了那些

sentences.en: who had fled to the highland as evildoers who were banished from Batavia's graveyard.
sentences.zh: 逃往高地的人是被驱逐出巴达维亚墓地的作恶者。

sentences.en: He claimed they had left without permission and ordered they be returned to him, along with the boat that Ari's
sentences.zh: 他声称他们未经许可就离开了，并下令将他们连同阿里斯的船一起交还给他

sentences.en: Yance had stolen.
sentences.zh: 扬斯偷走了。

sentences.en: Hayes didn't believe Cornelius' claims and instead imprisoned the mutineer who delivered the letter.
sentences.zh: 海斯不相信科尔内利的说法，反而将送信的叛变者监禁起来。

sentences.en: After several days passed with no reply or sign of his messenger, Cornelius launched an attack.
sentences.zh: 几天过去后没有任何回复或信使的迹象，科尔内利发动了进攻。

sentences.en: He sent his two chief executioners, David Zayvunk and Cornrat Van Hyssen, with twenty other mutineers.
sentences.zh: 他派出了他的两名首席刽子手大卫·扎伊文克和康拉特·范·海森，以及另外二十名叛变者。

sentences.en: Yet, they were forced to retreat as their adversaries had observed them approach and took up arMs. On August 5, Zayvunk and Van Hyssen attempted another incursion,
sentences.zh: 然而，由于对手观察到他们接近并拿起武器，他们被迫撤退。8月5日，扎伊文克和范·海森试图进行另一次入侵，

sentences.en: this time with all the mutineers.
sentences.zh: 这次带着所有的叛变者。

sentences.en: As they waded through the shallows towards the island, they were once again met by the well-prepared soldiers and were forced to turn back.
sentences.zh: 当他们蹚着浅水向岛屿走去时，再次遭到了准备充分的士兵们的迎击，被迫折返。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the inhabitants of Batavia's graveyard continued to suffer.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，“巴达维亚号”墓地的居民们继续遭受苦难。

sentences.en: By August, only seven women remained alive and all were forced into sexual slavery.
sentences.zh: 到了八月，只剩下七名女性还活着，并且全部沦为性奴隶。

sentences.en: Cornelius became fixated on Lucretia Yarns, who had already endured a demeaning assault at the hands of the mutineers while on the Batavia.
sentences.zh: 科内利乌斯迷恋上了卢克丽霞·亚恩斯，她在“巴达维亚号”上时就已经遭受过叛变者们的羞辱性袭击。

sentences.en: He attempted to seduce her by writing her poems and giving her wine, but she rejected his advances.
sentences.zh: 他试图通过写诗和送酒来诱惑她，但遭到她的拒绝。

sentences.en: After two weeks, Cornelius lost his temper and complained to David Zayvunk about the matter.
sentences.zh: 两周后，科内利乌斯失去耐心，向戴维·扎伊温克抱怨此事。

sentences.en: Zayvunk then threatened Lucretia with death if she didn't comply with Cornelius' wishes.
sentences.zh: 随后，扎伊温克威胁卢克丽霞，如果她不顺从科内利乌斯的意愿就杀了她。

sentences.en: So she submitted to his will.
sentences.zh: 于是她屈服了。

sentences.en: That same month, a boy was blindfolded under the guise of a joke, only to be decapitated.
sentences.zh: 同年同月，一个男孩在恶作剧的幌子下被蒙上双眼，随后惨遭斩首。

sentences.en: Hans Hardens, who had already endured the murder of his six-year-old daughter Hilatrine, also lost his wife when she was strangled with her own hair ribbon.
sentences.zh: 汉斯·哈登斯此前已经历了六岁女儿希拉特琳被谋杀的痛苦，如今他的妻子也用自己的发带被勒死，令他再次痛失亲人。

sentences.en: The man who led the survivors prior to Cornelius' arrival was stabbed with a pike and sword, then hit in the head with a mourning star.
sentences.zh: 在科内利斯到达之前领导幸存者的那名男子被长矛和剑刺死，随后头部又遭到晨星锤的重击。

sentences.en: The mutineers openly discussed whom they would like to murder next, and people were not permitted to mourn for their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 叛乱分子公开讨论他们接下来想谋杀谁，人们甚至不被允许为亲人哀悼。

sentences.en: Following the massacre of Gysbert Bastien's family, mutineers discovered him crying and stated,
sentences.zh: 在吉斯伯特·巴斯蒂安的家人遭到大屠杀后，叛乱分子发现他在哭泣并说道：

sentences.en: Be silent, or you go the same way.
sentences.zh: 闭嘴，否则你的下场和他们一样。

sentences.en: Gysbert's life was regularly threatened, but Cornelius believed he might prove a useful bargaining chip in the battle against the highland, so he was kept alive.
sentences.zh: 吉斯伯特的人生屡遭威胁，但科内利斯认为他在对抗高地的战斗中或许能成为有用的筹码，因此留了他一命。

sentences.en: By late
sentences.zh: 到了

sentences.en: August, winter was drawing to an end and it was raining less, resulting in depleting water supplies.
sentences.zh: 八月下旬，冬天即将结束，降雨减少，导致水源日渐枯竭。

sentences.en: Cornelius attempted yet another charge on the highland, this time with a more deceptive approach.
sentences.zh: 科尔内利乌斯对高地发动了又一次进攻，这一次采取了更具欺骗性的策略。

sentences.en: On September 1, he sent Gysbert Bastien's to negotiate a peace treaty with Private Hayes, who agreed to receive the mutineers the following day.
sentences.zh: 9月1日，他派吉斯贝尔特·巴斯蒂安斯与海斯列兵谈判和平条约，后者同意第二天接见叛变者。
zh_words: 吉斯贝尔特·巴斯蒂安斯

sentences.en: On September 2, the entire population of
sentences.zh: 9月2日，巴达维亚墓地的全体居民——

sentences.en: Batavia's graveyard, now reduced to 32 men and 6 women, travelled to the highland with Cornelius.
sentences.zh: 如今只剩下32名男子和6名妇女，与科尔内利乌斯一起前往高地。

sentences.en: They watched from the sandbank between islands as Cornelius and five of his most loyal followers continued onwards.
sentences.zh: 他们从岛屿之间的沙洲上看着科尔内利乌斯和他的五个最忠实的追随者继续前进。

sentences.en: They gifted their adversaries new clothes and red wine, which were well received.
sentences.zh: 他们向对手赠送了新衣服和红酒，受到了热烈欢迎。

sentences.en: As Cornelius and Hayes engaged in peace talks, the mutineers offered the soldiers from the highland jewels and money to switch sides.
sentences.zh: 正当科尔内利乌斯与海斯进行和平谈判时，叛变者向高地的士兵提供珠宝和金钱以让他们倒戈。

sentences.en: In response, the soldiers launched a surprise attack, arresting Cornelius and four of his men, including David Zevunk and Cornrat van Huyssen.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，士兵们发动了突袭，逮捕了科尔内利乌斯及其四名手下，其中包括大卫·泽温克和康拉特·范·海森。

sentences.en: One mutineer named Vauter Loos managed to escape and reach a small boat.
sentences.zh: 一名名叫沃特·洛斯的叛变者设法逃脱并抵达了一艘小船。

sentences.en: The mutineers waiting on the sandbank made a beeline for the soldiers, though they had to run almost half a kilometre to reach them.
sentences.zh: 在沙洲上等待的叛变者径直冲向士兵，尽管他们不得不跑了近半公里才接近目标。

sentences.en: They vastly outnumbered the soldiers, so Private Webby Hayes ordered the immediate execution of Cornelius's captured followers to scare the rest of the mutineers away.
sentences.zh: 由于人数远超士兵，二等兵韦比·海斯下令立即处决被俘的科尔内利乌斯追随者，以此吓退其余的叛变者。

sentences.en: Both David Zevunk and Cornrat van Huyssen were among those killed.
sentences.zh: 大卫·泽温克和康拉特·范·海森都在被杀的人之列。

sentences.en: The brutal display caused the approaching mutineers to retreat back to Batavia's graveyard, taking the innocent survivors with them.
sentences.zh: 这种残酷的示威迫使逼近的叛变者撤回了巴达维亚公墓，并带走了那些无辜的幸存者。

sentences.en: Euronymous Cornelius, now a prisoner of the highland, was placed in a limestone pit that functioned as a cell.
sentences.zh: 尤罗尼莫斯·科尔内利乌斯此时已沦为高地的囚犯，被关进了一个充当牢房的石灰石坑里。

sentences.en: He spent his days plucking feathers from birds that the soldiers had hunted.
sentences.zh: 他整天都在拔取士兵们猎获的鸟类的羽毛。

sentences.en: Over on Batavia's graveyard, a new ruler was elected from the mutineer's ranks,
sentences.zh: 而在巴达维亚公墓那边，叛变者阵营选举出了一位新首领，

sentences.en: 24-year-old Vauter Loos.
sentences.zh: 现年24岁的沃特·洛斯。

sentences.en: Under his authority, the murders ceased and women were no longer abused.
sentences.zh: 在他的管束下，谋杀停止了，妇女也不再受到虐待。

sentences.en: With Cornelius now gone, a number of men abandoned the cause, leaving fewer than 20 loyalists.
sentences.zh: 随着科尔内利乌斯离去，许多人放弃了这场叛乱，忠于叛军的死党只剩下不到20人。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, supplies on Batavia's graveyard were running low.
sentences.zh: 两周后，巴达维亚幸存者营地的物资已经所剩无几。

sentences.en: In a desperate bid to gain access to their water and food, Loos declared war on the highlands.
sentences.zh: 为了获取水和食物，罗斯孤注一掷，向高地宣战。

sentences.en: The battle commenced at 9am on September
sentences.zh: 战斗于9月
17日上午9点打响。

sentences.en: Though the remaining mutineers were now vastly outnumbered and didn't have the military experience
sentences.zh: 尽管剩下的叛乱分子在人数上处于绝对劣势，也没有军事经验

sentences.en: of their opponents, they did have two muskets, each capable of firing one round per minute.
sentences.zh: 像他们的对手那样，但他们有两支滑膛枪，每分钟都能发射一发子弹。

sentences.en: Private Webby Hayes and his men took cover behind rocks and in their fort, but the mutineers still managed to wound four soldiers, one of whom later died from his injuries.
sentences.zh: 二等兵韦比·海耶斯和他的手下躲在岩石后和堡垒里，但叛乱分子仍然设法打伤了四名士兵后来其中一人因伤势过重身亡。

sentences.en: The confrontation continued for several hours, until suddenly, in the early afternoon,
sentences.zh: 冲突持续了几个小时，直到午后不久，突然

sentences.en: a ship appeared on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 地平线上出现了一艘船。

sentences.en: Commander Francisco Pelsat and his group of 48 survivors had sailed for almost a month in an effort to reach the Batavia settlement in Indonesia for help.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯科·佩尔萨特指挥官和他的48名幸存者小组航行了近一个月，试图抵达印度尼西亚的巴达维亚定居点寻求帮助。

sentences.en: They suffered no losses over the course of their journey and successfully reached the Dutch settlement on July 7, 1629.
sentences.zh: 他们在整个旅程中没有人员伤亡，并于1629年7月7日成功抵达荷兰定居点。

sentences.en: Two days later, Pelsat was summoned to appear before the VOC's council to account for the loss of the company's new flagship vessel and its precious cargo.
sentences.zh: 两天后，佩尔萨特被传唤到VOC的理事会前，就公司新旗舰船只及其宝贵货物的损失做出说明。

sentences.en: Pelsat described the manner in which the Batavia had crashed into the reef, explaining that the majority of people on board had survived and they had managed to recover its most
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特描述了巴达维亚号撞上暗礁的过程，解释说船上绝大多数人都幸存了下来，并且他们设法捞回了

sentences.en: valuable iteMs. Among those who accompanied Pelsat to Batavia was his long-time adversary,
sentences.zh: 最有价值的物品。陪同佩尔萨特前往巴达维亚的人中包括他的老对手、

sentences.en: Captain Arian Jakobs.
sentences.zh: 船长阿里安·雅各布斯。

sentences.en: He was held accountable for his actions aboard the Batavia, including orchestrating the attack on Lucretia Yarns in a failed bid at mutiny.
sentences.zh: 他因其在巴达维亚号上的行为而被追究责任，包括策划对卢克雷蒂亚·扬斯的袭击以进行未遂哗变。

sentences.en: Both he and Batavia's bosun, Yarn Avertz, who Lucretia identified as the ringleader, were arrested.
sentences.zh: 他和卢克雷蒂亚指认为首谋的巴达维亚号船长助理扬·阿弗茨都被逮捕了。

sentences.en: After being tortured, Avertz confessed to his part in the mutiny and the assault of Lucretia and was executed by hanging.
sentences.zh: 经过酷刑逼供后，阿弗茨承认了自己参与哗变和袭击卢克雷蒂亚的罪行，并被绞死。

sentences.en: Captain Jakobs was ordered to stand trial for the faulty navigation that led to the Batavia becoming shipwrecked and his role in quote, a gross evil and public assault.
sentences.zh: 雅各布斯船长被命令接受审判，罪名是导致巴达维亚号触礁沉没的导航失误，以及他在所谓“严重罪恶和公开袭击”中所扮演的角色。

sentences.en: Commander Pelsat was granted another VOC ship named the
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特指挥官获准使用另一艘名为

sentences.en: Sardam to rescue the survivors he'd left behind and recover as much cargo as possible.
sentences.zh: 萨尔丹号的东印度公司船只，去营救他先前留下的人并尽可能捞回货物。

sentences.en: He departed Batavia on July 15 with a small crew and began sailing back towards the Abrolos Islands.
sentences.zh: 他于7月15日带着一小队船员从巴达维亚出发，开始驶回阿布罗洛斯群岛。

sentences.en: By August 10, they were less than 80 kilometres from the shipwreck site, but a navigation miscalculation as well as poor weather made it difficult to find the islands.
sentences.zh: 到8月10日，他们距离沉船地点已不到80公里，但导航计算失误加上恶劣天气，使得寻找群岛变得十分困难。

sentences.en: It took more than a month for them to orientate themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们花了一个多月才重新确认方位。

sentences.en: By September 13, the rescuers finally reached the northern end of the island chain.
sentences.zh: 到了9月13日，救援人员终于抵达了该群岛的最北端。

sentences.en: Three days later, on the evening of September 16, they sighted what remained of the Batavia and steered towards it the next morning.
sentences.zh: 三天后，即9月16日傍晚，他们看到了巴达维亚号的残骸，并在第二天早晨朝它驶去。

sentences.en: They dropped anchor at approximately midday on September 17, three kilometres from the highland and six and a half kilometres from Batavia's graveyard.
sentences.zh: 他们于9月17日大约正午时分抛锚，距离高地三公里，距离巴达维亚号的葬身之地六点五公里。

sentences.en: As soon as the mutineers caught sight of the rescue ship, they ceased their attack on the highland.
sentences.zh: 叛变者一看到救援船，就停止了对高地的进攻。

sentences.en: A boat was sighted rowing from the ship towards the smaller of the two highland islands, which sat south from where the battle was being waged.
sentences.zh: 人们看到有一艘小船从大船划向那两个高地岛屿中较小的一个，该岛位于激战发生地的南面。

sentences.en: A number of the mutineers, who were still dedicated to Cornelius' plan of commandeering a rescue vessel, immediately set sail for the Sardam.
sentences.zh: 一些叛变者仍然执着于科尔内利乌斯劫持救援船的计划，他们当即起航驶向萨尔丹号。

sentences.en: At the same time,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Private Webby Hayes and three of his men raced to their own makeshift boat, hoping that they would be able to reach the rescuers firSt. The two groups began frantically
sentences.zh: 韦比·海耶斯列兵和他的三名部下冲向他们自己的简易小船，希望能够抢先抵达救援人员那里。两组人开始疯狂地

sentences.en: rowing, trying to beat one another there.
sentences.zh: 划桨，试图抢在对方前面到达。

sentences.en: Commander Pelsard, along with several crew members, had loaded one of the Sardam's boats with supplies such as bread and water and headed towards the nearest visible land.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特指挥官与几名船员在萨尔丹号的一艘小船上装满了面包和水等补给，并朝着最近可见的陆地驶去。

sentences.en: Just as they reached its shores and disembarked, a boat carrying four men drew close.
sentences.zh: 就在他们抵达岸边并上岸时，一艘载着四个人的小船靠近了。

sentences.en: One of the men leapt out and shouted at them,
sentences.zh: 其中一人跳出来对他们大喊：

sentences.en: Welcome, but go back aboard immediately, for there is a party of miscreants on the islands near the wreck who have the intention to seize the yacht.
sentences.zh: 欢迎，但请立刻返回船上去，因为沉船附近的岛上有一伙歹徒，他们企图夺取这艘船。

sentences.en: The man was Private Webby Hayes.
sentences.zh: 这个人就是韦比·海耶斯列兵。

sentences.en: He quickly informed
sentences.zh: 他迅速将

sentences.en: Pelsard of the events that had taken place over the past few months.
sentences.zh: 过去几个月里发生的事情告知了佩尔萨特。

sentences.en: Pelsard set back out for the
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特再次动身前往

sentences.en: Sardam to warn the remainder of his crew.
sentences.zh: 萨尔丹号，以便警告他剩余的船员。

sentences.en: As he neared the ship, he saw the mutineers were also rapidly approaching in their boat.
sentences.zh: 当他接近船只时，他看到叛变者也正乘着小船快速逼近。

sentences.en: When the mutineers boarded the Sardam, they were greeted by guns and pikes.
sentences.zh: 当叛变者登上萨尔丹号时，迎接他们的是火枪和长矛。

sentences.en: Pelsard had made it aboard just in time to alert the crew of the ambush.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特及时登上了船，向船员们拉响了伏击警报。

sentences.en: The mutineers surrendered and were arrested.
sentences.zh: 叛变者投降并被逮捕。

sentences.en: During interrogations, they revealed they had killed more than 100 men, women and children under the order of Euronymous Cornelius.
sentences.zh: 在审讯期间，他们交代在尤罗尼穆斯·科尼利厄斯的命令下，他们已经杀害了100多名男子、妇女和儿童。

sentences.en: Some also admitted to being part of the original mutiny on the Batavia, revealing that Captain Arian Jacobs had been one of the masterminds behind it.
sentences.zh: 一些人还承认参与了巴达维亚号最初的哗变，并透露船长阿里安·雅各布斯是幕后主谋之一。

sentences.en: Cornelius was retrieved from his limestone prison and taken aboard the Sardam.
sentences.zh: 科尼利厄斯被从他的石灰石监狱中带出来，带上了萨尔丹号。

sentences.en: Upon seeing the bound man, Commander Pelsard looked at his former deputy with great sorrow, as he was, quote,
sentences.zh: 看到这个被捆绑的男人，指挥官佩尔萨特怀着无比悲痛的心情看着他曾经的副手，因为他，引号，

sentences.en: Such a scoundrel, cause of so many disasters, and of the shedding of human blood.
sentences.zh: 如此恶棍，引发了如此多的灾难，并导致了人类鲜血的流淌。

sentences.en: Cornelius tried to absolve himself of any guilt by implicating his various followers in the mutiny and murders, but his claims were rejected and he was locked up in a cell.
sentences.zh: 科尼利厄斯试图通过将他各种追随者牵连进叛变和谋杀来免除自己的罪责，但他的说法被驳回，并被关进了一个牢房里。

sentences.en: The following morning, Pelsard and several armed soldiers went to Batavia's graveyard to arrest the remaining mutineers and rescue the survivors.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，佩尔萨特和几名武装士兵前往巴达维亚号的墓地，逮捕其余的叛变者并营救幸存者。

sentences.en: They discovered crucial pieces of evidence on the island, including several oaths that
sentences.zh: 他们在岛上发现了关键的证据，包括几份

sentences.en: Cornelius had made his followers sign.
sentences.zh: 科尼利厄斯强迫他的追随者签署的誓言。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案室稍后将继续播出。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting
sentences.zh: 感谢支持

sentences.en: Dutch law at the time dictated that justice needed to be meted out as quickly as possible,
sentences.zh: 当时的荷兰法律规定，必须尽可能快地伸张正义，

sentences.en: so it was decided that the trials of the mutiny's ringleaders would be carried out on the islands where the crimes had taken place.
sentences.zh: 因此决定在犯罪发生的岛屿上对叛变首领进行审判。

sentences.en: Pelsard and five other high-ranking officials from the Sardam and the Batavia formed a council and began proceedings.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特与来自“萨尔丹”号和“巴达维亚”号的其他五名高级官员组成了委员会，并开始审理。

sentences.en: While the survivors were housed on the Sardam, the accused mutineers were kept prisoner on Seals Island, far away from everybody else.
sentences.zh: 幸存者被安置在“萨尔丹”号上，而被告叛变者则被关押在远离所有人的海豹岛上。

sentences.en: The defendants had no lawyers, so the trial solely consisted of Pelsard questioning witnesses.
sentences.zh: 被告没有辩护律师，因此审判完全由佩尔萨特盘问证人组成。

sentences.en: As only a few of the perpetrators would admit to their crimes, torture was used to elicit confessions from the others, including Cornelius.
sentences.zh: 由于只有少数肇事者承认罪行，审讯人员对其他人使用了酷刑来逼供，其中包括科内利斯。

sentences.en: Interrogators would strap the individual to a frame, then slowly pour water over their head until it covered their faces and hindered their ability to breathe.
sentences.zh: 审讯人员会将犯人绑在架子上，然后慢慢把水浇在他们头上，直到水没过脸部并阻碍呼吸。

sentences.en: They were then forced to drink the water, which led to extreme bloating and fainting if the torture lasted for an extended period.
sentences.zh: 随后，他们被迫喝水，如果酷刑持续时间较长，会导致极度腹胀和昏厥。

sentences.en: Cornelius endured several days of these sessions.
sentences.zh: 科内利斯忍受了好几天的这种折磨。

sentences.en: He had little hope of convincing the council he was innocent, as his former followers were willing to testify against him.
sentences.zh: 他几乎没有希望让委员会相信他是清白的，因为他以前的追随者愿意出庭指证他。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the recovered oaths proved his control over the inhabitants of
sentences.zh: 此外，恢复的誓言证明了他对居民的控制，

sentences.en: Batavia's graveyard.
sentences.zh: 巴达维亚的墓地。

sentences.en: He eventually acknowledged that he'd ordered the deaths of three dozen people and planned a mutiny on board the Batavia.
sentences.zh: 他最终承认自己下令杀害了三十六人，并在“巴达维亚”号上策划了一场哗变。

sentences.en: However, he blamed many of the remaining murders on the mutineers who had died in the failed attack on the highland.
sentences.zh: 然而，他将许多剩余的谋杀案归咎于在对高地的袭击失败中死去的叛变者。

sentences.en: After admitting to some of his crimes,
sentences.zh: 在承认了部分罪行后，

sentences.en: Cornelius attempted to delay his sentencing by reneging his confession, quibbling over small details at trial and asking to speak with his wife back in the Dutch Republic.
sentences.zh: 科内利斯试图通过推翻供词、在审判中对细节斤斤计较以及要求与远在荷兰共和国的妻子通话来拖延宣判。

sentences.en: He ultimately signed a confession on
sentences.zh: 他最终在

sentences.en: September 28 and was sentenced to have both his hands cut off and to be executed by hanging.
sentences.zh: 9月28日签署了一份供词，并被判处砍掉双手并被绞死。

sentences.en: Upset at the outcome, Cornelius stated,
sentences.zh: 科尔内利乌斯对结果感到不满，并宣称：

sentences.en: I see well they want my blood and my life, but God would not suffer that I shall die a shameful death.
sentences.zh: 我很清楚他们想要我的血和命，但上帝绝不会容忍我死得如此耻辱。

sentences.en: I know for certain, and you will all see it, that God will perform unto me this night a miracle, so that I shall not be hanged.
sentences.zh: 我深信不疑，你们所有人也都会看到，上帝今晚会为我显灵，让我免于绞刑。

sentences.en: On September 29, Cornelius attempted to take his own life by drinking poison, but survived and was in so much pain that he begged for an antidote.
sentences.zh: 9月29日，科尔内利乌斯试图通过服毒自杀，但他活了下来，且痛苦不堪，只得苦苦哀求解药。

sentences.en: His execution, along with the executions of seven other mutineers, took place on Seals Island on October 2, 1629.
sentences.zh: 1629年10月2日，他和另外七名叛变者在海豹岛被执行死刑。

sentences.en: Before Cornelius was led to a set of gallows, Lucretia Yarns confronted him and insisted he take responsibility for raping her.
sentences.zh: 在科尔内利乌斯被带到绞架前时，吕克蕾西亚·扬斯质问了他，并坚持要他为强奸她的行为承担责任。

sentences.en: He replied, It is true.
sentences.zh: 他回答道：确实如此。

sentences.en: You are not to blame.
sentences.zh: 这不是你的错。

sentences.en: The other mutineers sentenced to die asked that
sentences.zh: 其他被判处死刑的叛变者请求

sentences.en: Cornelius be killed first so that they could watch.
sentences.zh: 先处死科尔内利乌斯，这样他们就能亲眼目睹。

sentences.en: Their request was granted.
sentences.zh: 他们的请求得到了准许。

sentences.en: Cornelius refused spiritual absolution and instead hurled verbal abuse at his former followers.
sentences.zh: 科尔内利乌斯拒绝了宗教赦免，反而对昔日的追随者破口大骂。

sentences.en: Gaisber Bastienz, who lost his wife and six children in one night under the order of Cornelius, later wrote about his experiences.
sentences.zh: 盖斯伯特·巴斯蒂安兹曾在科尔内利乌斯的命令下一夜之间失去了妻子和六个孩子，他后来写下了自己的经历。

sentences.en: He described how Cornelius remained staunchly unrepentant, quote, saying even at the end as
sentences.zh: 他描述了科尔内利乌斯如何始终毫无悔意，引述道，甚至在最后

sentences.en: he mounted the gallows, revenge, revenge, so that to the end of his life he was an evil man.
sentences.zh: 他走上绞架时还在喊着“复仇，复仇”，直到生命的尽头他依然是个恶魔。

sentences.en: Over the years, many have speculated as to what motivated Euronymous Cornelius to orchestrate the deaths of so many innocent people.
sentences.zh: 多年来，许多人都在推测究竟是什么促使尤罗尼穆斯·科尔内利乌斯策划了如此多无辜之人的死亡。

sentences.en: Historian Mike Dash theorised that Cornelius was a psychopath due to his superficial charm, ability to manipulate others, lack of compassion, and impulsivity.
sentences.zh: 历史学家迈克·达什推测，由于科尔内利乌斯表面迷人、善于操纵他人、缺乏同情心且容易冲动，他是一个心理 psychopath（精神病态者）。

sentences.en: In his book, Batavia's Graveyard, Mike Dash writes,
sentences.zh: 迈克·达什在他的著作《巴达维亚的坟场》中写道：

sentences.en: Though years of casual usage have stripped the word of much of its meaning, true psychopaths are not evil men incapable of self-control.
sentences.zh: 尽管多年的日常使用已经剥夺了这个词的大部分含义，但真正的精神病态者并非无法自控的恶魔。

sentences.en: On the contrary, they are always chillingly in command of their emotions.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，他们总是能冷静地控制自己的情绪。

sentences.en: What they actually lack is empathy, the capacity to either understand or care what other people feel.
sentences.zh: 他们真正缺乏的是同理心，即理解或关心他人感受的能力。

sentences.en: Following Euronymous Cornelius' death, four other mutineers had their right hand severed and were subsequently killed, while the remaining three were merely executed.
sentences.zh: 在尤罗尼穆斯·科尔内利乌斯死后，另外四名叛变者的右手被砍断并随后被处决，而剩下的三人则直接被处决。

sentences.en: Their bodies were left out on display to remain hanging from the gallows until they decomposed.
sentences.zh: 他们的尸体被悬挂在绞架上示众，直到腐烂。

sentences.en: Nine remaining mutineers were to be taken to VOC headquarters in Batavia to be interrogated further.
sentences.zh: 剩下的九名叛变者将被带到巴达维亚的VOC（荷兰东印度公司）总部接受进一步审讯。

sentences.en: Nineteen men who signed oaths of loyalty to Cornelius were released unless incriminating evidence arose.
sentences.zh: 十九名签署效忠科尔内利乌斯誓词的人被释放，除非有新的 incriminating（罪证）出现。

sentences.en: Most of these individuals likely aligned with Cornelius to protect themselves or others.
sentences.zh: 这些人大多数是为了保护自己或他人而向科尔内利乌斯妥协的。

sentences.en: But a few of Cornelius' legitimate followers managed to remain undetected.
sentences.zh: 但科尔内利乌斯的一些死忠追随者设法隐藏了下来，没有被发现。

sentences.en: Before they embarked on their return journey to Batavia, Commander Pelsart was determined to salvage
sentences.zh: 在踏上返回巴达维亚的旅程之前，佩尔萨特指挥官决心从

sentences.en: anything and everything that he could from the shipwreck to please his superiors.
sentences.zh: 残骸中打捞出所有能够打捞的东西，以取悦他的上级。

sentences.en: Divers recovered ten out of the vessel's twelve chests of money.
sentences.zh: 潜水员找回了船上十二箱钱币中的十箱。

sentences.en: Of the missing two, one had been trapped beneath a cannon and was inaccessible, while the other was never found.
sentences.zh: 在失踪的两箱中，一箱被压在大炮下面无法取出，而另一箱则再也没有找到。

sentences.en: The islands were also searched for anything of value that could be given to the VOC, with Pelsart finding jewels and other goods that
sentences.zh: 岛上也搜寻了所有可以交给VOC的有价值物品，佩尔萨特找到了

sentences.en: Cornelius had hoarded for himself.
sentences.zh: 科尔内利乌斯为自己中饱私囊的珠宝和其他货物。

sentences.en: On October 12, the Sardam's captain was sent out with four other men to fetch a barrel of vinegar that had been sighted on a reef.
sentences.zh: 10月12日，萨尔丹号的船长带着另外四个人去取一个在暗礁上发现的醋桶。

sentences.en: Wild winds and rain ensued the following day.
sentences.zh: 第二天狂风暴雨随之而来。

sentences.en: The five men were spotted attempting to navigate through the storm, but never returned.
sentences.zh: 这五个人被看到试图在风暴中航行，但再也没有回来。

sentences.en: By mid-November
1629, what remained of the Batavia's wreckage on the reef had been driven almost entirely underwater by the waves.
sentences.zh: 11月中旬，巴达维亚号残留在暗礁上的残骸几乎已被海浪完全冲入水下。

sentences.en: Pelsart determined that nothing further could be saved and prepared to leave.
sentences.zh: 珀尔萨特确定再也无法抢救出任何东西，准备启程离开。

sentences.en: Before sailing north, he decided they should first travel to the Australian mainland in a last-ditch effort to see whether
sentences.zh: 在向北航行之前，他决定先带大家前往澳大利亚大陆，做最后一次努力，看看

sentences.en: Sardam's missing captain and sailors had made it to land.
sentences.zh: “萨尔丹”号失踪的船长和水手是否已经登上了陆地。

sentences.en: He also planned to maroon two of the mutineers there as punishment for their crimes.
sentences.zh: 他还计划将两名叛变者放逐在那里，作为对他们罪行的惩罚。

sentences.en: The stranded mutineers were Wouter Loos, who had led
sentences.zh: 被困的叛变者是沃特·洛斯——他在

sentences.en: Cornelius' men following his arrest and a cabin boy named Jan Pelgrim.
sentences.zh: 科尔内利乌斯被捕后领导了其手下，以及一个名叫扬·佩尔格林的船舱服务生。

sentences.en: The decision to abandon them was intended as merciful, as Pelsart did not believe Loos was as culpable as Cornelius, while Pelgrim was granted some leniency due to his youth.
sentences.zh: 流放他们的决定本意是仁慈的，因为珀尔萨特认为洛斯的罪责不如科尔内利乌斯重，而佩尔格林则因年幼而受到了一些宽大处理。

sentences.en: On November 16, Loos and Pelgrim were left with a boat and instructed to become familiar with the foreign land and its people in the hopes they might be able to find
sentences.zh: 11月16日，洛斯和佩尔格林被留下一艘小船，并被嘱咐去熟悉这片陌生的土地和当地人民，希望他们能够找到

sentences.en: gold, silver, or anything of value.
sentences.zh: 黄金、白银或任何有价值的东西。

sentences.en: If ships passed by their location, the pair were permitted to be rescued so they could report what they discovered.
sentences.zh: 如果有船只路过他们的所在地，两人获准被救援，以便他们能汇报自己的发现。

sentences.en: Abandoning the two mutineers on the coast of Western
sentences.zh: 将这两名叛变者遗弃在西澳大利亚

sentences.en: Australia made them the first Europeans to inhabit the country, 159 years before the first British colony was established in Sydney in 1788.
sentences.zh: 海岸，使他们成为了第一批在这片土地上生活的欧洲人，比1788年在悉尼建立第一个英国殖民地早了159年。

sentences.en: It is unknown what happened to them after they were abandoned, as the VOC never made any attempt to rescue them.
sentences.zh: 他们被遗弃后的命运不得而知，因为荷兰东印度公司（VOC）从未试图营救他们。

sentences.en: 200 years later, in 1829, the first permanent British settlement was established in Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 200年后的1829年，第一个英国永久定居点在西澳大利亚建立。

sentences.en: Reports were received of light-skinned
sentences.zh: 曾有人报告称，有肤色较浅的

sentences.en: Indigenous people having lived along the coaSt. Some have speculated whether this meant Loos and Pelgrim
sentences.zh: 土著人曾在海岸边生活。有人推测这是否意味着洛斯和佩尔格林

sentences.en: joined an Indigenous tribe and had children with them, but there is no evidence to support this.
sentences.zh: 加入了一个土著部落并与他们生了孩子，但没有证据支持这一说法。

sentences.en: For those on board the Sardam, the journey to Batavia took just under three weeks due to strong winds and the calmer spring weather.
sentences.zh: 对于“萨尔丹”号上的船员来说，由于强风和较平静的春季天气，前往巴达维亚的航程还不到三周。

sentences.en: They arrived on Wednesday, December 5, 1629.
sentences.zh: 他们于1629年12月5日星期三抵达。

sentences.en: Two months later, on January 31,
sentences.zh: 两个月后，即1月31日，

sentences.en: 1630, crowds gathered to watch the public sentencing and executions of the twelve remaining mutineers.
sentences.zh: 1630年，人群聚集在一起观看对剩下的十二名叛变者的公开宣判和行刑。

sentences.en: Six were hanged, with one having his right hand severed as well.
sentences.zh: 六人被绞死，其中一人还被砍掉了右手。

sentences.en: Three were publicly flogged and then sent into exile.
sentences.zh: 三人被当众鞭笞，随后流放。

sentences.en: Two of the younger mutineers, aged 15 and 17, were made to draw lots to see which of them
sentences.zh: 其中两名年仅15岁和17岁的年轻叛乱者被要求抽签，以决定他们之中

sentences.en: would be executed and which would only be flogged, with one being granted mercy due to their young age.
sentences.zh: 谁将被处决，谁只受鞭笞，其中一人因年纪尚轻而获得宽恕。

sentences.en: A particularly brutal mutineer named Jakob Peters was found to have participated in the original mutiny, as well as engineering the slaughter of Geisbert Bastien's family.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫雅各布·彼得斯的极其残忍的叛乱分子被发现不仅参与了最初的哗变，还策划了对盖斯贝尔·巴斯蒂安一家的屠杀。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to the most severe punishment possible, death by being broken on the wheel.
sentences.zh: 他被判处最严厉的刑罚——车裂至死。

sentences.en: It involved an individual being tied to a scaffold while an executioner used an iron bar to crush all of the bones in their arms and legs.
sentences.zh: 内容是一个人被绑在脚手架上，行刑者用铁棒砸碎其四肢的所有骨头。

sentences.en: They would then be placed on a huge cartwheel, hoisted upright and publicly displayed, with death sometimes taking hours to occur.
sentences.zh: 随后他们会被放置在一个巨大的大车轮上，竖起来公开展示，死亡有时要持续数小时才会降临。

sentences.en: Batavia's captain, Ariane Jakobs, refused to talk.
sentences.zh: 巴达维亚号的船长阿里安·雅各布斯拒绝开口。

sentences.en: Although he had been implicated in the mutiny on the Batavia, the only evidence was the accusations made by Commander Pelsard and some of those involved.
sentences.zh: 尽管他被牵连进巴达维亚号的叛变中，但唯一的证据只有佩尔萨德指挥官和部分涉案人员的指控。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, he remained in prison until June 1631 on unproven charges.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于罪名未得到证实，他一直在狱中关押到1631年6月。

sentences.en: After this, there are no further records of Jakobs, and it is believed he died in custody.
sentences.zh: 此后，再无雅各布斯的任何记录，据信他在拘留期间死亡。

sentences.en: A number of mutineers escaped capture and punishment for their actions.
sentences.zh: 许多叛变者逃脱了对其行径的抓捕和惩罚。

sentences.en: Four sailors who joined
sentences.zh: 有四名水手

sentences.en: Pelsard on the longboat that sailed to Batavia to get help had been part of Jakobs and Cornelius's original mutiny plot, and three had taken part in the assault of Lucretia Yarns.
sentences.zh: 曾加入雅各布斯和科内利斯的最初叛变密谋，他们乘坐佩尔萨德的长船前往巴达维亚寻求援助，其中三人还参与了对卢克雷蒂亚·扬斯的袭击。

sentences.en: However, they remained behind rather than participate in the rescue mission.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们留在了当地，没有参与救援任务。

sentences.en: Pelsard learned of their involvement when he interrogated the other mutineers, but by the time the Sardam returned to Batavia, they had disappeared.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特在审讯其他叛乱分子时得知了他们的参与，但当萨尔丹号返回巴达维亚时，他们已经消失了。

sentences.en: Of the more than 200 individuals who were marooned on the Abrolos Islands for three months,
sentences.zh: 在阿布罗洛斯群岛被困三个月的200多名幸存者中，

sentences.en: only 74 innocent survivors reached their final destination of Batavia, including five women and one child.
sentences.zh: 只有74名无辜的幸存者抵达了他们的最终目的地巴达维亚，其中包括五名妇女和一个孩子。

sentences.en: VOC archives indicate that 115 people were murdered by Cornelius and his followers, a figure that amounts to more than a third of the Batavia's original passengers.
sentences.zh: 荷兰东印度公司（VOC）的档案表明，有115人被科尼利斯及其追随者谋杀，这一数字占巴达维亚号最初乘客总数的三分之一以上。

sentences.en: Private Webby Hayes emerged as the hero of the tragedy for protecting those who had escaped Cornelius's men by establishing a stronghold on the highland.
sentences.zh: 列兵韦比·海耶斯通过在高地上建立据点，保护了那些逃脱科尼利斯手下魔掌的人，从而成为了这场悲剧的英雄。

sentences.en: He was promoted to the rank of sergeant, his salary was doubled, and he went on to have a successful military career.
sentences.zh: 他被晋升为中士，薪水翻倍，并开启了成功的军事生涯。

sentences.en: The men who fought alongside him also received promotions and wage increases.
sentences.zh: 与他并肩作战的士兵也得到了晋升和加薪。

sentences.en: For Lucretia Yarns, her arrival to the Batavia settlement in Indonesia resulted in further sorrow.
sentences.zh: 对于卢克丽霞·雅恩斯来说，她抵达印度尼西亚巴达维亚定居点后迎来了更多的悲伤。

sentences.en: The point of her journey was to reunite with her husband following the unexpected deaths of their three children.
sentences.zh: 她此行的目的是在三个孩子不幸夭折后与丈夫团聚。

sentences.en: However, he had been posted to Burma without her knowledge sometime earlier and had since died.
sentences.zh: 然而，就在不久前，他不知情地被派往了缅甸，并已在那里去世。

sentences.en: She opted to remain in Batavia and remarried in October 1630 before returning home to Amsterdam with her second husband in 1635.
sentences.zh: 她选择留在巴达维亚，并于1630年10月再婚，随后于1635年与第二任丈夫一同返回阿姆斯特丹的家乡。

sentences.en: Shortly after arriving at the Batavia settlement in December 1629, Guysbert Bastians decided to write to extended family members to relay the
sentences.zh: 1629年12月抵达巴达维亚定居点后不久，吉斯伯特·巴斯蒂安斯决定给远房亲戚写信，讲述

sentences.en: murder of his wife and children, as well as his experiences over the past few months.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子和孩子被谋杀，以及他在过去几个月里的经历。

sentences.en: He penned a lengthy letter, which later became one of the key records of the shipwreck and massacre.
sentences.zh: 他写了一封长信，后来这封信成为了这起海难和屠杀事件的关键记录之一。

sentences.en: Two years later, he remarried a widow and was sent to the Bander Islands, 2,000 kilometres east of Batavia, to minister to troops stationed there.
sentences.zh: 两年后，他与一位寡妇再婚，并被派往巴达维亚以东2000公里的班达群岛，为驻扎在那里的军队做牧师。

sentences.en: He later caught dysentery and died in the spring of 1633.
sentences.zh: 他后来染上了痢疾，并于1633年春季去世。

sentences.en: His daughter, Judic, had endured not only the loss of her family, but repeated sexual abuse during her time on Batavia's graveyard.
sentences.zh: 他的女儿朱迪克不仅承受了失去家庭的痛苦，还在巴达维亚的“墓地”期间遭受了多次性虐待。

sentences.en: To secure her future, she married a man after her rescue, but he died within a few months of their wedding.
sentences.zh: 为了保障未来的生活，她在获救后嫁给了一个男人，但他在婚礼后几个月内就去世了。

sentences.en: She remarried a year later, but her second husband passed away after four years of marriage.
sentences.zh: 一年后她再次改嫁，但她的第二任丈夫在结婚四年后也去世了。

sentences.en: Taking pity on Judic's situation, the VOC awarded her 600 guilders compensation – almost
sentences.zh: 同情朱迪克的处境，荷兰东印度公司授予她600荷兰盾的赔偿金——几乎相当于

sentences.en: 10,000 Australian dollars in today's currency.
sentences.zh: 当今货币的10,000澳大利亚元。

sentences.en: This enabled Judic to return to the Dutch Republic to live in relative comfort.
sentences.zh: 这使得朱迪克能够返回荷兰共和国过上相对舒适的生活。

sentences.en: Commander Francisco Pelsart was posted to Sumatra to be second in command of a military operation.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯科·佩尔萨特指挥官被派往苏门答腊担任一次军事行动的二把手。

sentences.en: He wrote a detailed journal about the Batavia shipwreck and subsequent events for his superiors.
sentences.zh: 他为上级写了一份关于巴达维亚号海难及随后事件的详细日志。

sentences.en: After reading it, the commanders of the VOC became displeased with Pelsart, believing that if he hadn't left the survivors without a leader on the islands,
sentences.zh: 阅读后，荷兰东印度公司的指挥官们对佩尔萨特感到不满，他们认为如果不是他把幸存者丢在岛上而没有留下领导人，

sentences.en: the massacre might have never occurred.
sentences.zh: 这场屠杀可能就永远不会发生了。

sentences.en: There were no real consequences for Pelsart as he had become gravely ill a month earlier and died in September 1630 at the age of 35.
sentences.zh: 佩尔萨特并没有受到真正的惩罚，因为他在一个月前就已重病缠身，并于1630年9月去世，享年35岁。

sentences.en: His journal, which provides a comprehensive account of the tragedy, has been translated into English and is stored in the Netherlands' state archives in the city of The Hague.
sentences.zh: 他的日志详细记录了这场悲剧，已被翻译成英文，并存放在海牙的荷兰国家档案馆中。

sentences.en: During the period when the VOC was journeying east through the Indian Ocean, a number of Dutch ships were wrecked along the dangerous and
sentences.zh: 在荷兰东印度公司向东穿越印度洋期间，许多荷兰船只在危险且

sentences.en: volatile West Australian coaSt. But the events that followed the Batavia colliding with Morning Reef in the Abrolis Islands made it the most notorious.
sentences.zh: 变化多端的西澳大利亚海岸失事。但巴达维亚号在阿布罗洛斯群岛撞上晨光礁后发生的事件，使其成为最臭名昭著的一桩。

sentences.en: Although the ship's story became infamous in the
sentences.zh: 尽管这艘船的故事在

sentences.en: Dutch Republic in the immediate aftermath, the exact location of the wreck became something of a mystery.
sentences.zh: 荷兰共和国随后的日子里变得臭名昭著，但沉船的具体位置却成了一个谜。

sentences.en: In 1840, Captain John Lord Stokes was charting the Abrolis Islands for Britain's Royal Navy when he came across some large beams on an island in the southern group.
sentences.zh: 1840年，约翰·洛德·斯托克斯船长正在为英国皇家海军绘制阿布罗洛斯群岛海图时，在南部群岛的一个岛屿上偶然发现了一些大横梁。

sentences.en: Convinced he had found the site of the wreck, he named the landmass Pelsart Island.
sentences.zh: 他确信自己找到了沉船地点，便将这片陆地命名为佩尔萨特岛。

sentences.en: In the 1950s, the story of the Batavia fascinated Perth-based journalist, novelist, and historian Henrietta Drake Brockman.
sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代，巴达维亚号的故事深深迷住了居住在珀斯的记者、小说家兼历史学家亨丽埃塔·德雷克-布罗克曼。

sentences.en: When she learned of the discovery of utensils, a pistol, and two human skeletons on inlets 80 kilometres north of Pelsart Island, she suspected Captain Stokes
sentences.zh: 当她得知在佩尔萨特岛以北80公里的海湾里发现了餐具、一把手枪和两具人类骨骼时，她怀疑斯托克斯船长

sentences.en: had mistaken the vessel's final resting place.
sentences.zh: 弄错了这艘船的最终安息之地。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Henrietta pointed out that Commander
sentences.zh: 此外，亨丽埃塔指出，指挥官

sentences.en: Francisco Pelsart had described wallabies in his writings, and the animals only lived on two islands in the northern group.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯科·佩尔萨特曾在著作中描述过小袋鼠，这种动物仅生活在北部群岛的两个岛屿上。

sentences.en: Around the same time, the region became popular with cray fishermen.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时期，该地区成了小龙虾渔民的热门去处。

sentences.en: One day in 1960, a fisherman uncovered a human skeleton as well as a pewter bell from a trumpet that was
sentences.zh: 1960年的一天，一名渔民发现了一具人类骨骼，还有一个小号上的锡镴铃铛，

sentences.en: inscribed with the year 1628, reigniting interest in the hunt for the Batavia.
sentences.zh: 上面刻着1628年，这重新点燃了人们对寻找“巴达维亚”号的兴趣。

sentences.en: In June 1963, Dave Johnson was setting lobster pots in the area when he sighted something below the water.
sentences.zh: 1963年6月，戴夫·约翰逊正在该地区放置龙虾笼，突然看到水下有什么东西。

sentences.en: He returned to the location on several occasions to re-examine the object, and at one stage was digging on an island nearby and uncovered a skeleton.
sentences.zh: 他曾多次返回该地点重新检查该物体，一度在附近的一个岛屿上挖掘并发现了一具骨骼。

sentences.en: He alerted diver Max Kramer of his finds, as Max was in search of the shipwreck.
sentences.zh: 他将自己的发现告知了潜水员马克斯·克雷默，因为马克斯一直在寻找这艘沉船。

sentences.en: On June 4 1963, exactly 334 years after the Batavia ran into Morning Reef, Max became the first person to
sentences.zh: 1963年6月4日，也就是“巴达维亚”号撞上晨礁整整334年后，马克斯成为第一个

sentences.en: dive on the long-lost ship, which was located about two miles from where Henrietta Drake Brockman had estimated it would be.
sentences.zh: 潜入这艘失踪已久的船只的人，该船位于亨丽埃塔·德雷克·布罗克曼估计位置大约两英里外。

sentences.en: The island where Dave Johnson had dug up the skeleton was now named Beacon Island, but centuries before had been dubbed Batavia's Graveyard.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·约翰逊挖出骨骼的岛屿现在被称为灯塔岛，但在几个世纪前，它曾被称为巴达维亚的墓地。

sentences.en: The two highland islands had been named
sentences.zh: 这两座高地岛屿在随后的几年里被命名为

sentences.en: East Wallaby and West Wallaby in the intervening years.
sentences.zh: 东小袋鼠岛和西小袋鼠岛。

sentences.en: While the gallows on Seals Island, where the bodies of Euronymous Cornelius and several of his followers were left on display, had long since
sentences.zh: 虽然海豹岛上的绞刑架——尤罗尼穆斯·科内利乌斯及其几名追随者的尸体曾被留在那里的陈列中——早已

sentences.en: disintegrated, remnants of Private Webby Hazer's stone fort remained on West Wallaby Island, making it the oldest European structure on Australian soil.
